articles.title: Safeguarding LLMs via Model-Agnostic Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge
articles.abstract: LLMs have advanced rapidly, raising growing concerns about their safety. Recent work has proposed approaches to detect and defend against attacks including defenses at decoding stage that leverage models' hidden states. However, existing decoding-stage defenses suffer from two limitations. First, they introduce a trade-off between safety and over-refusal, where strengthening safety degrades the model's helpfulness on benign queries. Second, many of these methods rely on internal hidden states and are thus restricted to specific architectures, incurring substantial overhead and limited generalization across models. To address these limitations, we introduce LADE (Latent Safety Signals for Defense), which leverages latent safety signals extracted by contrasting harmful and benign queries from dark knowledge (i.e., information carried by the output probability distribution beyond its argmax) in the first-token output probability distribution. Our key insight is that, beyond surface-level refusal tokens, the dark knowledge in the first-token distribution contains latent safety signals, defined as tokens whose probabilities differ sharply between harmful and benign queries. We show that these signals consistently align across LLMs, forming a model-agnostic direction that emerges from safety alignment. LADE consists of three components: (1) Extracting Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge, which selects top-k safety-discriminative tokens from the first-token probability distribution; (2) Tokenizer Mapping, which maps these tokens across different tokenizers to enable model-agnostic application; and (3) kNN-based Discrimination, which classifies queries via a k-Nearest Neighbors search over the mapped tokens. Across diverse LLMs and benchmarks, LADE is robust against a wide range of jailbreak attacks and lowers attack success rates while maintaining a competitive safety-utility trade-off.
articles.titleCn: 通过模型无关的潜在安全信号保护大型语言模型免受黑暗知识的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）发展迅速，引发了对其安全性的日益关注。近期研究提出了检测和防御攻击的方法，包括在解码阶段利用模型隐藏状态的防御措施。然而，现有的解码阶段防御存在两个局限性。首先，它们在安全性和过度拒绝之间引入了权衡，即增强安全性会降低模型对良性查询的有用性。其次，许多方法依赖于内部隐藏状态，因此仅限于特定架构，导致显著的额外开销和模型间泛化能力有限。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了LADE（用于防御的潜在安全信号），它利用从暗知识（即输出概率分布中超出其argmax的信息）中通过对比有害和良性查询在第一token输出概率分布中提取的潜在安全信号。我们的关键洞察是，除了表面层的拒绝token外，第一token分布中的暗知识包含潜在安全信号，这些信号被定义为在有害和良性查询中概率差异显著的特殊token。我们证明这些信号在LLMs中始终如一地保持一致，形成了一个与模型无关的方向，该方向源于安全对齐。LADE由三个组件构成：（1）从暗知识中提取潜在安全信号，它从第一token概率分布中选择top-k安全区分性token；（2）Tokenizer映射，它将这些token映射到不同的tokenizer上，以实现模型无关的应用；（3）基于kNN的区分，它通过在映射token上执行k-最近邻搜索来对查询进行分类。在多种LLMs和基准测试中，LADE能够抵抗广泛的越狱攻击，并在保持竞争性安全效用权衡的同时降低攻击成功率。

articles.title: Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI
articles.abstract: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.
articles.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Child Safety in AI (non-archival)
articles.titleCn: 并非孩子所表达：审计面向儿童的人工智能中的手语到文本安全界面
articles.abstractCn: 自动手语翻译（SLT）已进入消费产品领域，将美国手语转化为英文文本，用于听写、消息传递以及向对话助手提出查询。面向儿童的人工智能和平台信任与安全工具会决定文本内容，通过在未成年人账户上应用过滤器以及培养分类器对聊天消息进行评分。因此，使用SLT的儿童可以通过翻译触达这些安全防护措施。我们未发现任何公开记录的联合评估这两种技术的系统，而且目前部署的领先SLT模型既未在18岁以下使用者上进行训练，也未进行正式评估。那些改变否定、参与者角色、保密性、紧急性或寻求帮助的错误，可能会在不影响流畅性的情况下改变安全决策。本文提出对该边界进行以聋人视角为先导的部署前审计，包括故障分类法、净化场景模式、四种比较条件和四种结果指标。澳大利亚手语（Auslan）计划作为首个案例研究。

articles.title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
articles.abstract: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.
articles.titleCn: 关于开放式信息获取用于信息获取代理
articles.abstractCn: 信息获取是一个开放式的信息搜寻问题，其中互动可能朝许多潜在有价值的方向发展，需要信息获取者不断确定随着新信息的出现要追求哪些信息。在代理式获取中，这些决策可以委托给基础模型，但模型选择如何影响最终的信息搜寻行为尚未得到充分研究。我们研究了关于信息价值的判断在不同大型语言模型（LLMs）中的差异，以及这些差异如何塑造序列信息搜寻。我们首先在涵盖多个模型系列和参数规模的11个LLMs中检验这些判断，使用一套共享的信息和获取目标。然后，我们开发了一个受控的获取模拟，其中不同的模型面对相同的信息空间并使用相同的筛选规则，从而将判断与问题生成和受访者行为隔离开来。利用这一设置，我们描述了在获取过程中由特定模型信息搜寻偏好所产生的内容广度-深度行为。我们进一步检验了互动历史如何改变对潜在信息的评估和后续选择。通过敏感性分析和消融实验，我们测试了这些发现的稳健性和边界，包括信息获取者可用的机会、用于操作化信息搜寻偏好的响应标签、互动历史的存在，以及冗余是否明确相关于评估。该项目代码、数据和轨迹文件可在 https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation 获取。

articles.title: Closing Ambient Clinical Documentation Gaps with Automated Provider Queries
articles.abstract: Provider queries are clarifying requests sent by clinical documentation specialists to physicians to close gaps in the clinical note and ensure accurate billing. Prior work automates note drafting, ICD-10 coding, and order extraction assuming a complete transcript, leaving these gaps unaddressed. We study whether an LLM can automate the query loop, termed DAU (Draft, Ask, Update), across those three tasks. An audit of 3,000 real visits identifies the sources of missing documentation, from which we build five transcript-degradation benchmarks on public data. Analyzing 21k clarification turns on real conversations, we find useful-question predictors are task-specific: oracle confidence dominates, but note completeness needs only simple recall questions while ICD-10 coding needs harder, multi-option ones. About 9% of turns hurt performance, driven by redundant questions and non-answers that still trigger a rewrite. Deployment depends on learning "when not" as much as "what to" ask.
articles.titleCn: 通过自动化提供者查询关闭环境临床文档差距
articles.abstractCn: 提供方查询是由临床文档专家向医师发送的澄清请求，旨在填补临床记录中的空白并确保准确计费。以往的研究在假设转录完整的情况下自动化了记录起草、ICD-10编码和医嘱提取，但这些空白并未得到解决。我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）是否能在上述三项任务中自动化查询循环，该循环被称为DAU（起草、提问、更新）。对3,000次真实就诊的审计确定了缺失记录的来源，基于这些来源，我们在公开数据上构建了五个转录退化基准。通过分析21,000次真实对话中的澄清回合，我们发现有用的提问预测器具有任务特定性：预言者置信度占主导地位，但记录完整性只需要简单的回忆性问题，而ICD-10编码则需要更难的、多选项的问题。大约9%的回合损害了性能，这是由冗余问题和未回答的问题仍然触发重写所驱动的。部署取决于学习“何时不该”提问，与“该问什么”同样重要。

articles.title: In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI
articles.abstract: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.
articles.comment: 10 pages. AI for Access to Justice Workshop at ICAIL 2025
articles.titleCn: 在旧中融入新：通过生成式人工智能增强“经典”文档自动化
articles.abstractCn: 基于软件的法律援助系统利用了多种知识表示和推理形式。本文探讨了以专家系统风格和其他符号方法为基础的文档自动化服务如何有效地利用和被当前生成式人工智能方法所增强。我们讨论了可能的益处和挑战，并报告了使用大型语言模型识别和纠正普通人撰写文本中问题的初步实验结果。

articles.title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
articles.abstract: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.
articles.titleCn: 可审计的关于AI代理的声明
articles.abstractCn: 组织对其AI代理做出声明：每个人都会批准所有外部邮件，每项操作都会被记录，评估显示该代理可以安全部署。欧盟AI法案第12条要求高风险系统允许自动记录事件，但并未说明哪些记录可以证明特定声明。立场是：要验证一个关于代理的声明，必须首先明确其政策、范围、能够证明该声明的记录以及记录的创建者。通过调整保证协议的前提条件，我们将声明称为可审计的，当这些要素和决策规则在做出裁决前被固定，并且记录可获取时。这扩展了我们可审计代理框架中的政策可验证性维度，从单一操作扩展到声明。代理增加了三个条件：独立记录的覆盖、与每个操作参数绑定的授权，以及超越完整性的完整性。在一个显式模型下，我们证明在假设成立的情况下，支持是不可能的。声明检查表将该方法应用于六个常见的声明，这些声明基于当前的NIST、IETF和OWASP草案。一个案例研究展示了通过五个证据状态对一项声明进行验证的过程。最后，我们提供了一个实践框和针对操作员、购买者、审计员和标准制定者的步骤。

articles.title: AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation
articles.abstract: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant.
articles.titleCn: AlignQuant：用于高效LLM生成的瓦片对齐混合精度量化
articles.abstractCn: 细粒度混合精度量化为高效的大型语言模型推理提供了可能，但本地精度选择可能与常规GPU存储和计算单元产生冲突。这种精度边界不匹配限制了压缩转化为实际加速的可行性。我们引入了AlignQuant，这是一种训练后量化方法，它使用与GPU兼容的二维权重瓦片作为精度分配、紧凑存储和执行的共同单元。这种共享分区允许精度跟随输出通道内的敏感度。联合预填充/解码校准分数通过量化激活下的投影输出扰动，并使用语言模型损失梯度加权的精度降低。相位归一化分数优先为对模型整体权重存储预算中重要的相位有重要影响的瓦片分配更高精度。每个瓦片存储一个选定的表示，而相位专用内核重用打包的模型并扩展较低位重的INT8计算，使用8位激活。在涵盖3B到14B参数的四个LLM上，AlignQuant在保持模型质量的同时，比BF16实现了高达2.50倍的生成加速。评估进一步覆盖了三款GPU和高达64K token的上下文。这些结果表明，通过共享瓦片单元，本地精度灵活性和常规GPU执行可以共存。实现代码可在https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant获取。

articles.title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
articles.abstract: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.
articles.comment: Published in Proceedings of IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT) 2026
articles.titleCn: AccentCL：具有增量扩展的鲁棒口音分类
articles.abstractCn: 口音分类器通常使用固定的标签库进行训练，无法随着新数据的出现而适应新的口音类别。此外，由于不同语料库的录音条件存在差异，口音语音语料库常常表现出显著的类别不平衡和/或领域偏移。我们提出了AccentCL，一个针对英语口音分类的类别增量学习框架，该框架对类别不平衡和跨语料库领域偏移具有鲁棒性。AccentCL从冻结的Whisper-Large-v3编码器中提取多层表示，使用不平衡感知交叉熵损失来减少对多数口音类别的偏见，并使用领域均值对齐损失来最小化训练语料库间的分布均值偏移。然后通过基于重放的持续学习扩展标签空间，使用冻结的基础模型进行知识保留，并使用旧到新的边缘损失来减少对新添加类别的过度预测。在一个五类口音分类任务中，AccentCL实现了77.1%的平衡精度和76.9%的宏平均F1分数。我们进一步评估了模型增量整合两个新口音类别的能力：西班牙口音英语和中国口音英语。当将西班牙口音英语添加到预训练模型时，AccentCL在新类别上达到了83.3%的F1分数，同时在基础类别上保留了77.3%的平衡精度。当随后添加中国口音英语时，它在新类别上达到了61.8%的F1分数，同时保留了先前学习类别的77.6%的平衡精度。这些结果表明，AccentCL能够实现鲁棒的区域口音分类，同时允许在不完全重新训练的情况下添加新的口音类别。

articles.title: Who Wrote It Is Not Enough: Detecting Who Contributed the Insight
articles.abstract: As LLMs increasingly assist scientific writing and peer review, detecting who wrote the text is no longer sufficient: we need to determine who contributed the underlying insight. We introduce Insight Provenance, the task of identifying whether a review insight originates from a human, an LLM, or their hybrid contribution. We construct InsightProv-v0 from 4,057 scientific papers and 12,660 human reviews, simulating different levels of LLM involvement with GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek and annotating provenance at the sentence level. We show that strong performance on raw data can be misleading, as models exploit linguistic and textual-authorship shortcuts that degrade substantially under progressively debiased evaluation. We therefore propose a two-stage adversarial framework that suppresses shortcut signals while preserving provenance-relevant information. Beyond detection, extensive analyses reveal what makes intellectual authorship identifiable: paper grounding and neighboring review context provide complementary provenance signals, while human, hybrid, and AI insights systematically differ in their information sources and failure modes. Most strikingly, AI insights predominantly remain close to generic or paper-provided information, whereas human insights more often introduce external knowledge and independent judgment. These findings suggest that while wording can be rewritten by an LLM, the provenance of an idea leaves a deeper and more persistent signal.
articles.titleCn: 是谁写的《这还不够：检测谁贡献了见解》
articles.abstractCn: 随着大语言模型越来越多地协助科学写作和同行评审，仅仅检测文本的作者是谁已经不再足够：我们需要确定是谁贡献了基础见解。我们引入了“见解溯源”（Insight Provenance）这一任务，旨在识别同行评审中的见解是否源自人类、大语言模型，或两者的混合贡献。我们从4,057篇科学论文和12,660条人类评审中构建了InsightProv-v0，通过使用GPT-4o、Gemini和DeepSeek模拟不同层次的大语言模型参与度，并在句子级别标注溯源信息。我们发现，在原始数据上表现优异可能具有误导性，因为模型会利用语言和文本作者身份的捷径，而在逐步去偏评估下这些捷径的性能会大幅下降。因此，我们提出了一种两阶段对抗性框架，该框架抑制捷径信号，同时保留与溯源相关的信息。除了检测之外，广泛的分析揭示了什么使得智力作者的贡献可被识别：论文基础和邻近的评审上下文提供了互补的溯源信号，而人类、混合和人工智能见解在信息来源和失败模式上存在系统差异。最引人注目的是，人工智能见解主要仍接近通用信息或论文提供的信息，而人类见解则更常引入外部知识和独立判断。这些发现表明，虽然措辞可以被大语言模型重写，但见解的溯源会留下更深层次和更持久的信号。

articles.title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
articles.abstract: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.
articles.titleCn: 追踪并非永恒：视频世界模型保留隐藏物体的方式
articles.abstractCn: 视频世界模型追踪它们所能看到的物体；我们探究它们对看不见的物体保留了什么。我们将一个物体从冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器中隐藏起来，并将其对隐藏区域的预测与两个仅在该区域内不同的世界的编码器表示进行比较。预测器的决策部分保留了静止的物体，完全丢失了在容器内移动的物体，并在0.3秒内（V-JEPA自身管状掩码下为0.5秒；ViT-H在预训练的90%掩码率下将其保留至1.1秒）丢失了移动的物体；在投影中，一个痕迹仍然存在，位于中点以下，占基线复制最后视图保留的14-60%。信息确实存在：编码器在1.00时读取物体的存在，并保留封闭容器的内部内容可解码3.5秒，而预测器的输出，使用编码器自身的探针读取，在盒子关闭半秒后，仅在2%的场景中包含球。在渲染场景中，预测器方面缺乏持久性，而训练以先验的方式廉价地安装了它：在合成容器上进行3000步仅预测器步骤将这种信念从0.05提升到1.00，与两个匹配对照相比。它们还将IntPhys-2019从84.2%提升至93.3%，但无容器的课程同样如此，基准评估哪种训练习惯的变化取决于其评分规则。使用管状掩码的持续训练在操作和互联网风格视频中产生1.1-1.6秒的移动物体携带过，因此这种缺陷并非内在的潜在预测问题。VideoMAE几乎保留了一切，而Cosmos的下一标记预测保留了静止的隐藏物体，但没有保留在移动容器内携带的物体。

articles.title: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
articles.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.
articles.comment: Apple Foundation Models, 15 Pages, Edge LLMs
articles.titleCn: 阶梯式Moe：可配置推理复杂度的分段级路由
articles.abstractCn: 训练大型语言模型（LLMs）需要大量资源，而针对不同部署场景中不同的计算约束来调整它们仍然具有挑战性。虽然弹性架构能够实现灵活的模型部署，稀疏激活模型允许输入自适应计算，但现有方法将这些维度独立处理。此外，针对设备端边缘推理优化的模型需要符合服务设备的内存和计算限制。在本文中，我们引入了一个统一框架，将弹性结构与稀疏门控架构相结合，以创建能够同时适应部署约束和任务需求的模型。我们的方法采用一个依赖于上下文和目标效率规范的模型主干，使推理时能够对精度-效率权衡进行细粒度控制。该模型学习在弹性嵌套子网络中激活与任务相关的参数，允许单个模型跨越多个容量点，同时保持输入自适应路由。通过实验，我们证明可以创建一个模型，使其能够灵活使用1、2、3、4十亿参数，同时比其密集对应模型更准确（在知识密集型基准测试上提高2-5%），并且与静态版本相当，同时提供与密集模型相似的延迟指标。总体而言，我们通过共享模型参数节省了设备磁盘空间，允许基于可用的DRAM和计算能力进行灵活的服务，同时提供更准确的结果。

articles.title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
articles.abstract: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
articles.titleCn: 基于教义的战术战斗伤员救治视觉问答数据集
articles.abstractCn: 战术战斗伤亡救治（TC3）要求响应者将伤情观察和干预措施与既定的临床指导相结合。为了支持这一过程，开发视觉语言模型需要将可见证据与可追溯的指导原则相链接的监督。我们提出了TC3-VQA，这是一个从公开的TC3教学和现场视频以及权威TC3文件构建的数据集。它包含581个条目，涵盖11个概念，有1860个问题涉及干预识别、指导原则、临床推理、程序指导以及在视觉信息不足时的拒绝。基于指导原则的答案保留了原文段落和字符偏移。构建过程结合了视觉标注、段落检索、蕴涵检查和跨模型系列的验证。设备框、解剖标签、时间片段和源元数据伴随着问答对。由两名医生和两名医学生进行的自动审核和评分描述了标注质量，其中88个保留条目有人工评分。该数据集为适应TC3的视觉语言模型、研究视觉证据与临床知识之间的联系以及评估识别、指导原则召回和拒绝提供了资源。

articles.title: Logbook: Extremely Long-form Audio Event Understanding
articles.abstract: Audio benchmarks are built around short, pre-segmented clips, limiting model design to brief inputs or fixed vocabularies. To close this gap, we introduce Logbook, a benchmark for hour-scale audio understanding, with recordings ranging from ten minutes to six days. Given a continuous audio recording and an event label vocabulary, a system must predict a gap-free segmentation with an event label and a description per segment. We compare 52 systems, end-to-end and cascaded, and ablate fine-tuning, context length, and reasoning budget. We find the task tractable, though the best systems remain below the human reference. Also, over-segmentation is pervasive, and fine-tuning partially mitigates it. Finally, end-to-end are often better than cascaded systems, but degrades with longer context.
articles.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Source code available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/logbook
articles.titleCn: 日志簿：超长音频事件理解
articles.abstractCn: 音频基准测试通常基于短时、预先分割的片段，这限制了模型设计只能处理简短输入或固定词汇。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Logbook，这是一个用于小时级音频理解的基准测试，其录音时间从十分钟到六天不等。给定一段连续的音频录音和事件标签词汇表，系统必须预测出无间隙的分割，并为每个片段提供事件标签和描述。我们比较了52个端到端和级联的系统，并消融了微调、上下文长度和推理预算。我们发现这项任务可行，但最佳系统仍低于人类参考水平。此外，过度分割现象普遍存在，而微调可以部分缓解这一问题。最后，端到端系统通常优于级联系统，但随着上下文长度的增加，其性能会下降。

articles.title: Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.
articles.titleCn: 为自主强化学习构建MoE专家选择结构
articles.abstractCn: 长时程大语言模型智能体通常采用稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型实现，但智能体行为与MoE结构的协同设计仍待深入探索。本研究全面研究了智能体微调后与MoE专家选择之间的关联。在现成的MoE模型中，我们观察到专家选择呈现特定结构，自然契合智能体行为轨迹。具体而言，当智能体执行语义相似操作（如读取、更新）的回合之间，专家路由的重叠度高于执行不同操作的回合。然而，标准强化学习算法忽视了这种特殊性，导致MoE路由在训练过程中失控，从而在实验中限制了任务性能和推理效率。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种面向智能体任务的分层路由控制框架。我们明确鼓励回合级专家选择与智能体操作对齐，同时正则化词元级专家选择以保持局部一致性。为解决采用该方法进行微调时出现的稳定性问题，我们进一步引入了熵门控机制。总体而言，我们的路由控制框架在所有评估基准上的成功率均提升了10个百分点以上。这些结果表明，智能体行为轨迹结构为优化RL微调过程中的MoE容量提供了有效信号。

articles.title: SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents
articles.abstract: Agent tasks require sequences of interdependent decisions. Autoregressive models support more flexible decision interfaces than conventional classifiers but incur the latency of token-by-token generation. Recent shared-prefix methods reduce this cost by reusing encoded context and scoring multiple decisions in parallel, but do not model decision dependencies or verify execution. We propose SharedKV-BT, where each active node of a behavior tree (BT) exposes stage-local fields and candidates, and Shared-KV scores the candidates in parallel and passes the selected decision to a separate execution system. We tested SharedKV-BT on robot manipulation, mobile navigation, and computer-use tasks. Across three tasks, SharedKV-BT made typed decisions 2.36-4.15 times faster than prompt-matched autoregressive decoding. On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Last updated on October 5th, 2026
articles.titleCn: SharedKV-BT：行为树智能体的本地类型化决策
articles.abstractCn: 智能体任务需要一系列相互依赖的决策。自回归模型比传统分类器支持更灵活的决策接口，但会带来逐个生成标记的延迟。最近提出的共享前缀方法通过重用编码的上下文并行评分多个决策来降低这种成本，但它们不建模决策依赖性或验证执行。我们提出了SharedKV-BT，其中行为树（BT）的每个活动节点都暴露出阶段局部字段和候选者，Shared-KV并行评分候选者并将选定的决策传递给一个独立的执行系统。我们在机器人操作、移动导航和计算机使用任务上测试了SharedKV-BT。在三个任务中，SharedKV-BT比提示匹配的自回归解码器在类型决策上快2.36-4.15倍。在操作任务中，节点局部Shared-KV将关节决策准确率从75%提高到94%，闭环成功率从0%提高到60%。固定评分策略回放表明，阶段门控防止了顺序错误的动作，外部后置条件防止了过早完成。

articles.title: Kurate: Scalable Scientific Quality Analysis
articles.abstract: Scientific search systems can find papers that are relevant to a question, but they generally do not assess the quality of the evidence that those papers provide. We present Kurate, a system that uses large language models (LLMs) to assess the quality of published studies. Kurate uses both the paper and its related documents (e.g., the study's trial registration and protocol), and links each of its judgments to the passage of text on which that judgment is based. We applied Kurate to a corpus of 4,347 papers (3,913 of which report randomized trials) and scored each paper on 8 dimensions of study design and reporting: specifically, statistical power, causal identification, preregistration, selective reporting, measurement validity, analysis prespecification, reporting transparency, and conflict of interest and funding. Across the corpus, we found that papers most often exhibited issues with statistical power, selective reporting, and analysis prespecification, although average quality differed between clinical areas. When compared against expert annotations of 60 held-out clinical-trial documents, the information Kurate extracted matched the expert label in 221/242 protocol scorepoints and 294/370 results-publication scorepoints, with AC1 0.94 and 0.81, respectively. Using a well-reputed, high quality clinical trial as a worked example, we show how a single paper's overall grade breaks down into separate judgments, with each linked to specific evidence from the trial's registration, protocol, and published report. Together, these results show that large-scale quality assessment of this kind is feasible, and that it can be used to address meta-scientific research questions.
articles.titleCn: Kurate：可扩展的科学质量分析
articles.abstractCn: 科学搜索系统可以找到与问题相关的论文，但它们通常不会评估这些论文所提供证据的质量。我们提出了Kurate系统，该系统使用大型语言模型（LLMs）来评估已发表研究的质量。Kurate同时使用论文及其相关文档（例如研究的试验注册和方案），并将每个判断与其所依据的文本段落链接起来。我们将Kurate应用于4,347篇论文的语料库（其中3,913篇报告了随机试验），并根据研究设计和报告的8个维度对每篇论文进行评分：具体包括统计功效、因果关系识别、预先注册、选择性报告、测量效度、分析预先指定、报告透明度和利益冲突与资金。在语料库中，我们发现论文最常出现的问题是统计功效、选择性报告和分析预先指定，尽管不同临床领域的平均质量有所不同。与60份保留的临床试验文档的专家标注相比，Kurate提取的信息在242个方案评分点和370个结果发布评分点中分别与专家标签匹配了221个和294个，AC1得分分别为0.94和0.81。我们以一个声誉良好、高质量的临床试验为例，展示了单篇论文的整体评分如何分解为独立的判断，每个判断都与试验注册、方案和已发表报告中的具体证据相关联。这些结果表明，大规模的质量评估是可行的，并且可以用于解决元科学研究问题。

articles.title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
articles.abstract: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic. Existing agent-memory systems (e.g., MemGPT, Zep, A-MEM) gate retrieval by content, ownership, and role, not derivation, missing a cached insight that embeds a forbidden column. We introduce the Analytical Memory Unit (AMU), a memory schema that attaches a full derivation (lineage) graph to every cached result, gated by a retrieval policy that serves a hit only when the requester is authorised for every column touched. Provided lineage recording is complete, we prove by construction that the policy blocks retrieval of results derived from a sensitive column outside the requester's permissions, at O(n) worst case -- a conditional design guarantee, not an empirical claim, that excludes derived features encoding sensitive information without naming their source. Eliminating measured leakage required 75-90% recorded lineage completeness, so we treat 90% as a conservative deployment target. Across six experiments, lineage-gated retrieval removes the 18.8-25.5% cross-department leakage naive content-gated memory suffers, keeping 81.5-82.6% of memory reuse at 13.8 microsecond worst-case overhead. A real-agent proof-of-concept with LLM-generated SQL is consistent with the guarantee: zero leaks over 9 round-trips, two conflicts caught automatically -- though a feasibility demonstration, not evidence of production viability. This offers a practical governance layer for shared agent memory, complementing source-layer access control and supporting EU AI Act compliance.
articles.titleCn: 谱系感知内存治理：一种用于企业AI代理中隐私保护列级访问控制的推导门控框架
articles.abstractCn: 共享内存存储的企业AI代理面临着两个尚未解决的风险：敏感数据可能通过请求者无法推导的合法计算结果泄露，以及不同部门可能通过冲突逻辑无声地计算同名的关键绩效指标（KPI）。现有的代理-内存系统（例如MemGPT、Zep、A-MEM）通过内容、所有权和角色来控制检索，而非推导过程，从而遗漏了嵌入禁止列的缓存洞察。我们引入了分析内存单元（AMU），这是一种内存架构，它为每个缓存结果附加一个完整的推导（谱系）图，并通过检索策略进行控制，该策略仅在请求者被授权访问所有涉及的列时才返回结果。如果谱系记录完整，我们通过构造证明，该策略能够阻止检索来自请求者权限范围之外的敏感列推导出的结果，最坏情况下为O(n)——这是一个条件设计保证，而非经验性声明，它排除了未指明来源的编码敏感信息的衍生特征。消除测量到的泄露需要75%-90%的记录谱系完整性，因此我们将90%视为保守的部署目标。在六项实验中，谱系门控检索消除了原始内容门控内存所遭受的18.8%-25.5%的跨部门泄露，同时保持了81.5%-82.6%的内存重用率，最坏情况下开销为13.8微秒。一个使用LLM生成的SQL的实时代理概念验证与该保证一致：9轮交互中零泄露，自动捕获了2次冲突——尽管这是一个可行性演示，而非生产可行性的证据。这为共享代理内存提供了一种实用的治理层，补充了源层访问控制，并支持欧盟AI法案的合规性。

articles.title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.
articles.titleCn: 最小见证强化学习
articles.abstractCn: “哪些不可约条件足以产生一个结果？”是计算和科学领域中反复出现的一个最常见的问题。对其答案，即最小充分见证，就是我们所说的解释、机制和原因。这些问题通常要求找出多个最小见证，但标准的强化学习方法可能只能揭示一个解决方案或冗余的解决方案。我们将此问题形式化为最小见证识别，并引入了最小见证强化学习（MWRL）。MWRL取自策略中成功提案样本所认证的集合的并集，并将每个提案的信用归因于如果没有该提案，该组并集将失去的覆盖范围。这种信用分配直接源于问题定义，将最小性和从单个黑盒验证器位中恢复替代方案的需求统一起来。根据这一原则，我们推导出一种能够恢复整个见证家族的价值迭代规划器，以及一种可扩展到大型语言模型的策略梯度方法。在不同的实验设置中，MWRL恢复了大多数最小见证，而其他方法则返回冗余的超集或单个见证。通过使见证家族能够从验证器反馈中学习，MWRL将强化学习的范围扩展到单解优化之外。我们的代码可在https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL获取。

articles.title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
articles.abstract: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.
articles.titleCn: TIDE 2.0：一个开放、模型无关的临床记录键控去识别引擎
articles.abstractCn: 临床记录记录了患者护理的大部分内容，但在删除受保护健康信息（PHI）之前，它们不能用于研究。去识别化通常被视为一个检测问题。仅靠检测是不够的：编辑删除了临床内容以及标识符，日期空白破坏了纵向分析所需的时序间隔，每次出现时分配一个全新的随机代理会破坏患者记录之间的关联。我们提出了TIDE 2.0，这是一个具有MIT许可的引擎，包含两个可分离的阶段：一个可互换的识别器和一把键控匿名器。两者都在机构拥有的硬件上运行。代理通过密码学生成，没有存储的关联表。日期通过每个患者的间隔保持偏移量进行偏移；在给定键下，每个值在所有出现时都获得相同的代理；在新的键下生成的发布无法与早期的发布关联。我们还发布了TIDE2-Sentry，这是一个从大型语言模型中提炼出的识别器。在两个机构提供的两个金标注语料库上，默认配置在领域内达到了0.88的片段级召回率，在第二个机构的语料库上达到了0.77，精确度分别为0.88和0.87。我们报告了每个类别的召回率和精确度，以及这些汇总数据。该引擎是开源的，识别器在受限制的研究使用协议下提供，因此机构可以在自己的环境中运行、检查和扩展两者。

articles.title: Forecasting the Growth of Social Media Information Cascades: Towards Human-in-the-Loop Misinformation Triage
articles.abstract: Limited review teams must identify which emerging claims are likely to keep growing before their eventual reach is known. We center early misinformation triage on this continuation-forecasting problem: predicting subsequent recorded propagation-tree growth from the first 30 minutes of activity. On FibVID, we compare early node count with structural depth entropy, temporal arrival entropy, and their pair while keeping all propagation trees from each original claim in one partition. Across 352 test trees from 59 claim groups separate from training, the combined model raises $R^2$ for log-transformed future growth from 0.307 to 0.323 and reduces log-MAE by 2.4% (95% claim-bootstrap CI, -0.4% to 5.2%). The gain is especially pronounced among 97 high-activity trees: $R^2$ rises from 0.248 to 0.395, Spearman's $ρ$ from 0.394 to 0.529, and log-MAE falls by 11.7% (95% CI, -1.9% to 23.9%). Complementing the 30-minute growth forecast, we analyze the first 15 replies in 563 PHEME threads. In this cohort, the 15th reply arrives after a median of 28.8 minutes; 52.0% reach the fixed reply prefix within 30 minutes and 71.6% within one hour. Even without the LLM-generated factual-accuracy dimension, the remaining stance, communicative, and affective state composition retains cross-event ranking signal (ROC-AUC 0.538); including that dimension increases ROC-AUC to 0.562. In a separate Check-COVID evaluation of 229 claims, reciprocal-rank fusion retrieves a gold evidence document within the top five for 74.2% of claims and within the top 20 for 94.3%; sentence reranking reaches Recall@20 of 58.1%. We propose an integrated human-review system that brings these early forecasts, response patterns, and retrieved evidence together for misinformation triage relying on the potential virality of claims.
articles.comment: Work done as part of the SHTEM Internship at Stanford University
articles.titleCn: 预测社交媒体信息级联的增长：迈向人机协同的虚假信息筛选
articles.abstractCn: 有限的审核团队必须在最终传播范围未知之前，识别出哪些新兴主张可能会持续增长。我们将早期虚假信息筛选的重点放在延续性预测问题上：根据活动最初的30分钟内记录的传播树增长来预测后续的传播情况。在FibVID上，我们比较了早期节点数量与结构深度熵、时间到达熵及其组合，同时将每个原始主张的所有传播树保持在同一个分区中。在来自训练集的59个主张组中的352棵测试树中，组合模型将未来增长的日志转换$R^2$从0.307提高到0.323，并将日志MAE降低了2.4%（95%主张自举CI，-0.4%至5.2%）。这种提升在97棵高活动树中尤为显著：$R^2$从0.248提高到0.395，Spearman's $ρ$从0.394提高到0.529，日志MAE降低了11.7%（95% CI，-1.9%至23.9%）。补充30分钟的传播预测，我们分析了563个PHEME线程中的前15条回复。在这个群体中，第15条回复的中位到达时间是28.8分钟；52.0%在30分钟内达到固定回复前缀，71.6%在1小时内达到。即使没有LLM生成的真实准确性维度，剩余的立场、沟通和情感状态组合仍然保留跨事件的排名信号（ROC-AUC 0.538）；包括该维度将ROC-AUC提高到0.562。在一个独立的Check-COVID评估中，针对229个主张，互惠排名融合在74.2%的主张中检索到黄金证据文档位于前五，在94.3%的主张中位于前20；句子重新排序达到Recall@20的58.1%。我们提出一个集成人类审核系统，将这些早期预测、回复模式和检索到的证据结合起来，用于基于主张潜在病毒性的虚假信息筛选。

articles.title: Responsible Institutional Analytics: Interpreting Bias with AI Support
articles.abstract: Institutional Analytics (IA) dashboards inform decision-making in higher education, yet data limitations, constraints in analytical techniques, and missing contextual information often affect their interpretation. To support more responsible interpretation of IA, we introduce FACTRIA, a framework that organizes potential biasing factors across four areas: the analytics pipeline, institutional context, course-level characteristics, and demographics. We used the FACTRIA framework as input to a generative-AI chatbot designed to prompt users to reflect on these factors while analyzing IA. A qualitative study with stakeholders, drawing on four authentic IA cases, and a transition network analysis showed that the chatbot prompted participants to recognize how overlooked factors influenced their initial interpretation. Findings indicated that combining a structured framework with AI-based guidance can enhance context-aware, responsible interpretation of institutional data.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Universal Computer Science (J.UCS)
articles.titleCn: 负责任的机构分析：借助人工智能解读偏见
articles.abstractCn: 机构分析（IA）仪表板为高等教育决策提供信息，但数据限制、分析技术约束以及缺失的背景信息常常影响其解读。为支持IA的更负责任的解读，我们引入了FACTRIA框架，该框架将潜在的偏倚因素组织为四个领域：分析流程、机构背景、课程级特征和人口统计。我们使用FACTRIA框架作为生成式AI聊天机的输入，该聊天机旨在提示用户在分析IA时反思这些因素。一项基于利益相关者的定性研究，结合了四个真实的IA案例，以及过渡网络分析表明，聊天机促使参与者认识到被忽视的因素如何影响了他们的初始解读。研究结果表明，结合结构化框架与AI指导可以增强机构数据的情境感知、负责任解读。

articles.title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
articles.abstract: Large language models make claims about themselves that are both consequential and increasingly difficult to verify from behavior alone. How can we distinguish plausible confabulations from genuine introspection? In this paper, we identify mechanistic signatures of faithful self-report in a controlled setting. Using low-rank adapters, we train models to make decisions on behalf of fictitious characters, according to latent linear preference functions. We find sustained fine-tuning on an implicit decision task can lead to the emergence of accurate self-reporting of models' learned preferences, even without explicit self-report supervision. We ask two research questions about this emergent phenomenon. First: is the emergence of accurate self-reporting accompanied by a measurable structural change in the model? Weight ablations and frozen-layer experiments together indicate that preference representations shift to earlier layers over training, consistent with the hypothesis that faithful self-report requires preferences to be located where pre-existing verbalization mechanisms can access them. Second: can these structural differences distinguish faithful models from unfaithful ones? Using attribution patching, we find that faithful models exhibit significantly higher attribution similarity between the decision-making and self-report tasks -- a mechanistic signature of faithful self-report that does not require us to understand the content of the report itself. Previous work on self-report has observed behaviorally that models can be faithful or unfaithful; our work proposes that, at least in our restricted setting, it is possible to distinguish between the two patterns of computation by examining the structure of the networks themselves.
articles.comment: Published at COLM 2026. Project page: https://iii.baulab.info
articles.titleCn: 从内部识别内省
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型会做出对自己有重大影响的声明，而这些声明正变得越来越难以仅凭行为来验证。我们如何区分看似合理的编造与真实的自我反思？在本文中，我们在受控环境下识别了忠实自我报告的机制特征。我们使用低秩适配器，训练模型根据潜在线性偏好函数为虚构角色做出决策。我们发现，在隐式决策任务上进行持续微调，即使没有显式的自我报告监督，也能导致模型对其学习到的偏好的准确自我报告的出现。我们针对这一涌现现象提出了两个研究问题。首先：准确自我报告的出现是否伴随着模型中可测量的结构变化？权重消融和冻结层实验表明，偏好表示在训练过程中会转移到更早的层，这与忠实自我报告需要偏好位于现有语言机制可以访问的位置的假设一致。其次：这些结构差异能否区分忠实模型与不忠实模型？使用归因补丁技术，我们发现忠实模型在决策任务和自我报告任务之间表现出显著更高的归因相似性——这是忠实自我报告的机制特征，无需我们理解报告的内容本身。以往关于自我报告的研究在行为上观察到模型可以是忠实的或不忠实的；我们的研究提出，至少在我们的受限环境下，通过检查网络结构本身，有可能区分这两种计算模式。

articles.title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
articles.abstract: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.
articles.titleCn: 从人类研究决策轨迹中学习科学探索
articles.abstractCn: 在为科学研究构建人工智能系统时，一个关键挑战是实现“科学探索”：通过一系列研究决策和行动，系统地调查未知现象或想法以获取新知识的过程。然而，这一过程在现有的科学语料库中几乎缺失；例如，研究论文主要记录最终成果，而非产生这些成果的轨迹。在这项工作中，我们引入了“ResearchTrails”，一个由Git仓库构建的“人类研究轨迹数据集”，其中“提交历史”作为研究探索的代理。我们开发了一个自动化且可扩展的流程，从仓库提交中提取结构化的研究轨迹，捕捉方法、实验和消融的连续变化。我们描述了由此产生的数据集，并表明这些轨迹包含了超越最终论文所揭示的关于中间研究决策的有意义信号。我们进一步展示了ResearchTrails在多个用例中的效用，包括在测试时检索人类研究经验作为外部技能，以及基于研究轨迹训练模型以改进对新研究决策的泛化能力。我们的结果表明，人工智能系统不仅可以从科学成果中学习，还可以从发现过程的演变本身中学习。

articles.title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
articles.abstract: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.
articles.titleCn: CLM作为裁判：在公共裁判基准上评估一个开放对比决策模型
articles.abstractCn: 一个开放对比决策模型在硬公共基准上的表现接近随机猜测：Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B得分在0.351（四次最佳中，随机概率为0.250）到0.593（两两对比中，随机概率为0.500）之间，在RM-Bench和JudgeBench上与抛硬币表现无统计学差异，并且对每个HaluEval项目都用一个固定标签回答，与0.581的始终优先基线表现相同。参数数量相同的决策者得分显著更高：奖励模型达到0.764到0.976，生成式决策者达到0.611到0.778，并且所有与CLM的差距在Benjamini-Hochberg校正后均显著。两种特性有效：原始置信度高估了置信度高达+0.401，但通过在保留的校准项目上拟合一个温度池，预期校准误差可修复至最多0.062，修复后的置信度在六个基准中的三个上使模型的自身错误高于随机水平。决策顺序翻转率仅为0.0002，而生成式决策者为0.2188，长度偏好偏移为-0.023，而生成式决策者为-0.217。然而，置信度门控级联在0.923到1.000的项目上升级至强决策者，在预先注册的0.97保留阈值：接近随机决策者的校准置信度几乎没什么可保留的。设计：五个公共偏好基准和一个带真实标签的幻觉基准，在预先注册的冻结状态下评分，该冻结状态在看到任何测试项目之前完成，与生成式、奖励模型和简单基线对比，并发布每项预测。

articles.title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
articles.abstract: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中柏拉图表征理论
articles.abstractCn: 翻译句子的表征在多语言模型的内部层是相似的——这一观察与柏拉图表征假说相关，但理论上尚未解释。我们基于数据具有隐藏层次结构的假设提供解释，其中抽象层次在语言间共享，而表层则具有模态或语言特异性。具体而言，我们从共享上层但不同下层生成规则的随机上下文无关文法生成合成语言。在此设置中，贝叶斯最优的下一个标记预测器是信念传播（BP）；将其消息编码在连续层中会产生与在同一数据上训练的转换器高度一致的解析预测。该框架解释了跨语言相似性为何在中间层达到峰值、与语言特异性结构共存，并随着语言邻近性、模型质量和数据接触的增加而增强。它区分了相似性（共享邻域几何形状）与对齐（共享坐标），表明后者在混合语言数据，即混合语言句子足够丰富时发生。它进一步预测，从每一层中减去从前一层线性可预测的分量会增加跨语言相似性，我们在预训练的大型语言模型中验证了这一预测。

articles.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
articles.abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
articles.titleCn: 基础模型可以通过借鉴训练数据来推理。
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们研究了训练数据如何将基础模型响应开头的标记与后续的推理行为建立关联。首先，我们证明，固定特定的起始标记提示可以使基础模型在数学和编程任务上的表现与强化学习（RL）训练的模型相当。例如，提示".\n\nOkay"将Olmo-3-7B在MATH-500上的pass@1准确率从42%提高到78%，而"Alright,"将Qwen3-14B从72%提高到87%。其次，强化学习使这些提示更可能出现，而固定这些提示则能恢复其相对于基础模型的大部分性能提升。第三，我们将标记提示的推理效果追溯到训练数据。我们进行因果数据干预，将任意单词（如"chicken"）转变为有效的推理提示，或移除现有提示的效果。类似的编辑使提示指令"Think duck duck goose"在引发推理方面与"Think step by step"同样有效。我们还发现，不同提示诱导的隐藏状态表示与训练集中的不同文档类型相关。最后，我们通过语言模型安全领域的案例研究扩展了对标记提示的研究，发现不同的提示会引发不同的拒绝和顺从行为，这些行为与不同类型的训练数据相对应。

articles.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
articles.abstract: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.
articles.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Website: https://berkearda.github.io/croissantminer/
articles.titleCn: CroissantMiner：用于机器学习数据集的Croissant元数据自动提取与验证
articles.abstractCn: 羊角面包已成为机器可读数据集元数据的基准，但填充其字段仍然是一项劳动密集型工作，需要仔细阅读相关数据集文档。我们提出了首个支持端到端评估符合社区标准架构的元数据提取的基准。该基准包含602篇论文，其中102篇具有人工验证的金标注注，500篇具有大型语言模型生成的银标注注，涵盖了完整的羊角面包架构，包括核心字段和负责任人工智能（RAI）字段。利用该基准，我们在一个结合基于规则的评分和经人工审核选择的大型语言模型裁判的两层评估框架下，评估了一系列提取系统，涵盖前沿模型、开放权重模型和代理架构。我们发现单次提取始终优于我们评估的四种代理架构：在骨干网络方面，这些分解变体实现的准确率低于单次全上下文提取。最大的差距出现在长格式RAI字段上，这些字段需要综合和解释分散在论文中的信息，而不是从单一位置复制信息，在这种场景下，当前系统仍然远未达到可靠水平。我们发布了基准、评估代码、裁判审核、实时演示以及向新系统开放的排行榜。

articles.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
articles.abstract: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
articles.titleCn: 递归视频情境学习用于自主机器人
articles.abstractCn: 通过文本记忆，能够协调冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的LLM代理在多个回合中不断改进，这种记忆记录了代理的行为，但并未记录任务如何完成。一个演示视频展示了这一点，但与代理的上下文结合不佳。完整视频会减慢每个回合的速度，固定的关键帧会丢失决定抓取是否成功的接触细节，而代理在规划时所需的任务结构会转变为围绕每个接触的帧。我们引入了递归视频上下文学习（RV-ICL），这是一种无需训练的方法，它将演示转化为代理可以导航的层次结构，而不是接收到的提示。该层次结构由演示的子事件构建，例如抓取和释放。其级别逐渐细化，从整个任务的关键帧到阶段、时刻和短片段，并通过只读工具呈现。代理在规划前会读取粗略级别。在执行过程中，每当一个步骤需要更多细节时，它会重新进入层次结构，并仅加载当前子目标的片段。每个任务只需要一个演示。基于RPent构建的RV-ICL将LIBERO-PRO的成功率从92.6%提高到96.5%，将LIBERO-Plus的成功率从86.7%提高到95.8%。

articles.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
articles.titleCn: MemPilot：为LLM代理按需编排多模态记忆管理
articles.abstractCn: 记忆已成为大语言模型智能体生态系统的重要组成部分，支持跨交互的信息保留和复用。然而，大多数现有智能体记忆系统以查询无关的方式构建记忆，这会导致不必要的预处理成本，并丢弃后来证明至关重要的细节。近期研究开始将记忆处理转向运行时自适应，但通常专注于特定操作或固定处理方案，导致对性能、成本和延迟的灵活控制远未得到充分探索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了\textbf{MemPilot}，一个灵活的框架，根据不同的性能—成本—延迟偏好来协调按需记忆管理。具体而言，我们通过强化学习优化一个多步大语言模型策略，以迭代方式在从查询无关记忆中检索和将原始多模态历史委托给异构大语言模型和视觉语言模型进行查询特定管理之间进行选择。该策略联合控制证据量、管理指令、模型选择和视觉访问，实现运行时计算的细粒度分配。为在竞争性目标下优化该策略，我们通过在聚合前分别估计每个目标的优势来调整目标优势解耦。此外，我们引入基于前缀的边际效用估计，以在多步回滚中进行细粒度归因。在五个多模态智能体—记忆基准测试上的实验表明，在优化偏好方面，性能—成本—延迟权衡具有有利性，偏好扫描产生的边界比现有的权衡感知基线更广阔。

articles.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
articles.abstract: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.
articles.titleCn: CLIFT：用于网络代理训练和测试时扩展的共形自验证
articles.abstractCn: 开源网络代理现在足以执行现实的浏览器任务，但使用强化学习训练它们仍然依赖于弱监督：二元任务成功对于信用分配来说过于稀疏，而前沿语言模型裁判在每一步调用成本太高，且无法假设在部署时可用。我们引入了CLIFT，这是一种基于一致性自我验证的训练和测试时扩展方法。在训练期间，代理回答关于其自身推进的自然语言验证问题；组合一致性认证器仅保留URL条件证据与训练时裁判一致的提问信号，通过极性感知提升分配带符号的信任权重，并将生成的验证器分数以永不减去裁判基线的方式混合到每步奖励中。在测试时，相同的认证库被冻结并作为结构化证据用于一致性轨迹选择（CTS）：代理采样一个贪婪推进和一个或多个多样化的重试，自我验证器总结每个URL轨迹，并采用保守多数投票规则选择是否从当前候选者中替换，而无需调用任何外部裁判。这一单一机制支持三种设置。在WebArena Infinity上，CLIFT在开源网络代理中实现了最先进的性能。在VisualWebArena上，使用开放模型训练的银行在测试时迁移到GPT-5.5，并在规范框架下达到最先进的性能。在Online Mind2Web上，无需在基准上训练代理，将认证问题银行翻译为改进实时网络代理的无监督评估。这些结果共同将一致性自我验证定位为一种将昂贵的裁判反馈转化为可重复使用的训练信号和无需裁判的测试时扩展信号的方法。

articles.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
articles.abstract: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.
articles.titleCn: PlotGround：将图表数字化与真实科学图形及其源数据相结合
articles.abstractCn: 科学图表通常编码着难以直接以机器可读形式获取的定量结果，因此精确的图表数字化对于验证和复用已发表的发现至关重要。然而，当前模型从真实科学图表中恢复绘制值的确切程度尚不明确，因为现有的基准主要依赖于合成图表或仅涵盖有限范围的图表类型。我们引入PlotGround，这是一个从真实科学图表及其作者发布的源数据中构建图表数字化基准的自动化流程。PlotGround将图表映射到源表格，识别可重建的图表区域，并生成具有源数据支撑参考值的定量问题。我们使用PlotGround构建了PlotGround-1k，这是一个包含1,119个问题的、经人工验证的基准，这些问题来自1,066篇bioRxiv预印本。在16种多模态模型中，最佳模型的精度达到在±5%相对误差容限下的87.5%。将容限收紧至±2%会降低每个模型的精度11-24个百分点，揭示了近似视觉阅读与精确定量恢复之间的差距。PlotGround的图表-源数据配对结构使我们能够比较从图表和源表格中恢复相同值的准确性。提供源表格而非图表将编码代理的精度从90.0%提高到97.4%，同时成本降低了72%。

articles.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
articles.abstract: We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them. Paradee keeps Kokoro's architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher. It has 10x fewer parameters and needs 15x less compute. We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features. We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher's saved values into the teacher's audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially. Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8. It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop. Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25x faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher's 4.52. The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz. A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters. Code, model files and audio samples are at https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee
articles.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee. Model and audio samples: https://huggingface.co/sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.0
articles.titleCn: Paradee：将Kokoro-82M提炼为8M参数的单人语音文本到语音模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们将广泛使用的开放文本到语音模型Kokoro-82M（包含54种声音）蒸馏为Paradee，这是一个仅包含8.07M参数的模型，能够说出其中一种声音。Paradee保留了Kokoro的架构，但层宽大大缩小，其两半部分分别独立地针对冻结的教师模型进行训练。它的参数数量减少了10倍，计算需求也降低了15倍。我们首先使用教师模型合成语料库，并保留其时长、音高、能量和音素特征。然后，我们训练一个小型文本侧模型来预测这些值，以及一个小型解码器将教师模型保存的值转换为教师的音频，首先使用频谱损失，然后进行对抗训练。最后，我们将两半部分连接起来，并将权重量化为int8。它无需对齐学习，也无需联合训练，并且可以在一台笔记本电脑上运行。以int8格式存储，Paradee的大小为8.5 MB，在单个CPU线程上运行速度比实时快25倍，在UTMOS上的得分为4.41，而教师模型的得分为4.52。学生模型最初存在轻微的嗡嗡声，我们将其追溯到2至8 kHz之间的浊音语音阶段。在合成后应用相位锁定滤波器可以去除大部分嗡嗡声，无需训练和额外参数。代码、模型文件和音频样本可在https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee获取。

articles.title: Jailbreaking Open-Weight LLMs via Random Embedding Perturbations
articles.abstract: While open-weight models have enjoyed steady progress in capabilities and wide adoption across multiple domains, their safety remains an important concern. One key feature is the ability to refuse or deflect harmful, malicious, or insensitive prompts. In this paper, we expose safety vulnerabilities across six common open-weight LLMs of various sizes that consistently lead to harmful or unsafe responses on the JailbreakBench benchmark dataset. Our proposed attack, Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV), is a simple and fast "jailbreaking" technique that is cheaper than prior approaches, which typically require gradient computations, per-prompt optimizations, or altering internal weights of the models. PEV just adds independent Gaussian noise in the embedding vector representations of the prompt, with no need for further manipulations. To generate unsafe responses, we repeatedly sample additive noise from this distribution. In our experiments, we observe that the average compute cost to get the first successful attack is up to an order of magnitude less than previous attacks. The first successful jailbreak on a new prompt typically arrives within one minute on every tested model, and PEV generates unsafe responses across all models for all prompts in JailbreakBench. No other tested method achieves such results, despite them taking longer to run. More broadly, we believe that understanding the behavior of LLMs under perturbations in the embedding vectors is an important research direction: while perturbations constitute a major security risk, they can also serve as a valuable tool for exploring the dynamical behavior of such models.
articles.titleCn: 通过随机嵌入扰动破解开放权重LLM
articles.abstractCn: 尽管开放权重模型在能力提升和跨多个领域的广泛采用方面取得了稳步进展，但它们的安全性仍然是一个重要关注点。一个关键特性是拒绝或回避有害、恶意或不敏感的提示。在本文中，我们揭示了六种常见开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）在不同规模下的安全漏洞，这些漏洞在JailbreakBench基准数据集上始终导致有害或不安全的响应。我们提出的攻击方法——扰动嵌入向量（PEV）——是一种简单快速的“越狱”技术，其成本低于先前方法，这些方法通常需要梯度计算、逐提示优化或修改模型内部权重。PEV只需在提示的嵌入向量表示中添加独立的高斯噪声，无需进一步操作。为了生成不安全的响应，我们从该分布中反复采样加性噪声。在我们的实验中，我们发现获得首次成功攻击的平均计算成本比先前攻击低一个数量级。在所有测试模型上，针对新提示的首次成功越狱通常在一分钟内出现，并且PEV在JailbreakBench的所有模型和所有提示上都生成不安全响应。尽管其他测试方法运行时间更长，但它们并未取得如此结果。更广泛地说，我们认为理解LLM在嵌入向量扰动下的行为是一个重要的研究方向：虽然扰动构成重大安全风险，但它们也可以作为探索此类模型动态行为的宝贵工具。

articles.title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
articles.abstract: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.
articles.titleCn: T-Search：一个开放的智能检索器和困难多步搜索的试验场
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了T-Search，一个用于复杂多步搜索的开权重量级智能检索器。给定一个问题和固定语料库上的搜索工具，它运行有界的多轮搜索，并返回带有简短解释的证据片段排名列表，将答案生成交给下游模型处理，因此后端和生成器可以无需重新训练即可互换。T-Search基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B构建，并在对抗性筛选的合成搜索任务上进行训练，采用回合切片监督微调，随后在召回奖励上进行GSPO优化。在七个带有黄金证据标注的英语和俄语基准测试中，它在一轮回滚时达到56.0的Recall@10，比基础模型高出14.4个百分点，在三轮融合回滚时达到61.3，超越了更大的开放模型。我们发布了该模型、控制台、在线演示以及三个基准测试，包括TRuST，这是首个原生俄语复杂搜索基准测试。

articles.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
articles.abstract: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.

articles.titleCn: IdeaLens：检测长篇写作中的AI想法
articles.abstractCn: 现代AI检测器能够识别出文字的作者，而新兴的AI使用政策则越来越关注一个不同的问题：这些想法是由谁提出的？我们介绍了IdeaLens，这是一种能够判断文档中的想法是人类还是AI提出的检测器（即想法来源），无论这些文字是由谁书写的。为了使IdeaLens专注于想法而非文字，我们将文档表示为提纲：一系列将话语角色与内容简短释义配对的条目列表，以最大限度地减少与原始文本的字级重叠。我们在1M个FineWeb文档上使用来自Pangram（一种文字来源检测器）的银标标签训练IdeaLens。由于提纲在很大程度上去除了表层信息，标签必须主要通过想法进行拟合。在一项受控研究中，随着模型从越来越详细的人类计划中撰写内容，IdeaLens的AI标记率从95%降至7%，而Pangram 4仍然标记92%；从AI生成的计划中撰写时，IdeaLens始终保持在96%以上。相反，在50个由人类作者根据AI生成计划撰写的故事新数据集中，IdeaLens将68%的故事标记为AI，而Pangram 4仅标记8%。在19个现有的检测基准的综合套件中，我们展示了IdeaLens在低误报率下保持了强大的检测率，这表明想法本身提供了强大的判别信号，并且其性能跨越了领域、格式和语言。最后，我们检查了IdeaLens的90K个预测，以表征人类和AI构思之间的系统性差异。我们发布了我们的模型和标记数据集，以促进未来关于想法来源检测的研究。

articles.title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
articles.abstract: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.
articles.titleCn: 平衡记忆通路：分析并改进混合语言模型的内存利用率
articles.abstractCn: 交替使用注意力层和循环层的循环注意力混合语言模型（LMs），越来越多地被用于结合循环层的效率与注意力层的强大性能。先前研究表明，注意力层和循环层为利用过去信息提供了互补的途径：注意力支持从早期标记中精确地回忆信息，而循环层支持在长上下文中整合不同信息。然而，我们观察到，仅仅能够访问这两种途径并不意味着混合LMs有效地使用了它们。我们发现它们严重依赖注意力层而非循环状态。标准的监督微调可以提高整体性能，但并未改善两种记忆途径的协调方式：模型变得更加依赖注意力层传播的信息，而其使用循环层传播信息的程度仍然有限。为了促进两种记忆途径之间的更好协调，我们增加了一个辅助损失，该损失限制注意力层对早期上下文的访问，同时让循环状态在整个序列中传播。这一目标鼓励模型通过注意力层和循环途径同时保留和使用信息。它提高了整体性能，在涉及较长上下文或需要信息聚合的任务上取得了显著提升，这与分析中观察到的循环层的优势一致。关键在于，这种不平衡和我们的辅助损失带来的好处具有泛化性：它们适用于多个问答和代理任务中的循环注意力LMs，以及结合不同记忆形式的基于注意力的LMs。总而言之，我们的研究结果表明，仅仅提供多种记忆途径并不能保证它们的有效使用，需要针对性的监督来更好地协调它们。

articles.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
articles.abstract: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

articles.titleCn: ufakzeka-karar：一种开放式的土耳其语类型化决策模型，具有顺序不变的选项评分
articles.abstractCn: ufakzeka-karar是一个具有1,824,944,666参数的开源土耳其决策模型。给定一段土耳其语文本和固定答案类型的问题（选择、有序等级上的级别或yes/no），它返回每个选项的温度调整概率和预期误差，作为“不确定”信号，无需生成文本，并在一次CPU前向传递中为最多十个选项。基于实验室的ufakzeka-1-base构建，其头部在共享位置对每个选项进行盲评分，因此答案不依赖于选项顺序。一个使用打乱选项顺序训练的顺序头部在仅改变选项顺序时，其答案准确率约为相同，但改变了2.3%到2.8%；而REINFORCE的宏观F1得分下降了10.2分（0.102），交叉熵损失。在HakemBench v1.0的开放集（4,275个问题，7个赛道）上，发布的模型排名第16行中的第7位，综合得分为0.660（95%置信区间为0.642至0.677）。温度调整降低了开发集上的校准误差（平滑ECE），但在保留的支持问题上增加了误差，从0.027到0.045，这是首次评分运行，它从未在这些问题上进行过训练；发布的模型后来在这些问题上进行了训练，因此其0.036至0.064并非未见过问题的测试。发布的模型是三次在HakemBench上评分运行中的最后一次，其数据并非盲测。第二次运行的新训练数据旨在针对第一次运行在完整测试集上在护栏、审核和客户支持方面的错误，而发布的运行是在第二次运行在完整测试集上的护栏结果被阅读后进行的，该协议在它的任何数据、代码或运行之前以书面形式固定。所有这些数据均在此之后；它的护栏、审核和客户支持数据带有“受测试结果阅读影响的标记”。在其他四个赛道上评分的每个模型，其综合得分为0.678，排名第16位。权重和代码遵循Apache-2.0许可。

articles.title: Improving Diversity in LLM Short Story Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity. We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM, an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality. Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs.
articles.titleCn: 提升LLM短篇故事生成的多样性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成准确的回复，但这些回复缺乏多样性。我们尝试针对创意短篇故事生成任务解决这个问题。借鉴既定的写作规范和已知的LLM局限性，我们旨在实现流派、语气、风格和命名实体等方面的变化。为在这些维度上促进多样性，我们引入了DivLM，这是一个由两个阶段组成的大型语言模型后训练框架。首先，我们在创意写作语料库上进行持续预训练，并利用权重残差恢复指令遵循能力。然后，我们应用强化学习，并采用定制的复合奖励函数，该函数联合最大化目标叙事维度上的多样性，同时保持回复质量。我们在两个LLM系列上的实证结果表明，与替代方法相比，DivLM平均使多样性指标提高了9%以上，同时保留了指令遵循能力、整体回复质量和与人类输出的相似性。

articles.title: Domain adaptation of Russian ModernBERT for long legal documents
articles.abstract: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens.
