Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F1 scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.
articles.titleCn: 俄罗斯现代BERT模型在长法律文档上的领域自适应
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了在俄罗斯立法文件上继续预训练是否能够提升俄罗斯现代BERT编码器在法律文本上的表现。经过适配的模型RuModernBERT-ruLaw是在一个据报道包含304,382份立法文件和194,425,905个语料标记的语料库上训练的。语料库标记数量与模型分词器产生的位置是不同的。我们在一个固定的外部集合（包含1,031个法院判决片段）上比较了原始编码器和适配编码器。在五种掩码实现中的每一种，两个模型都接收相同的隐藏位置。在最大输入长度为512、2,048和8,192个标记时，平均掩码标记交叉熵分别降低了0.10942、0.07052和0.06604个自然对数单位。报告的95%区间总结了在这个固定集合上对掩码的敏感性；它们并未量化跨文档集合的不确定性。第二次评估关注法律实体提取。原始模型和适配模型在实体级别的F1分数分别为0.99852和0.99820。然而，99.95%的测试跨度在训练分割中具有相同的归一化表面形式和类别。因此，这次评估对迁移到未见过的形式提供了有限的证据。论文使用可编辑图表和清晰标注的示例解释了掩码目标、重叠窗口、平均规则和精确实体边界评分。比较支持所研究的模型对和语料库在掩码标记预测损失方面的较低表现。但它并未分离出远程上下文的贡献，也未确立其实际法律效用。

articles.title: SAFE-MR: Evidence Sufficiency Learning for Selective Multimodal Rumor Detection
articles.abstract: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image-text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim-evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.
articles.titleCn: SAFE-MR：选择性多模态谣言检测的证据充分性学习
articles.abstractCn: 多模态谣言检测器越来越依赖检索到的证据，但相关证据未必足以验证。缺失来源、重复报告和未解决的矛盾可能在没有充分支持的情况下产生自信的预测。我们引入SAFE-MR框架，该框架将声明的真实性与其证据的充分性分离。该方法将图像-文本帖子分解为可验证的声明，构建了关系感知的声明-证据图，并利用来源和上下文兼容性聚合证据。分离的真实性和充分性头支持选择性预测，而证据干预则鼓励在无关添加下的稳定性以及对证据移除的敏感性。在NewsCLIPpings、VERITE和XFacta数据集上，SAFE-MR分别达到了91.2%、75.8%和85.2%的宏观F1分数。与匹配的证据主干相比，其宏观F1分数分别提升了2.2、4.9和4.8个百分点。在诊断选择集上，SAFE-MR将最大概率拒绝的AURC从0.105降低到0.075，并将80%覆盖率时的错误率从13.8%降至8.5%。证据扰动和消融实验结果支持充分性学习和干预训练在改进选择性验证中的作用。

articles.title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
articles.abstract: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
articles.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SENTIRE 2026 (ICDM 2026 Workshops)
articles.titleCn: 解读情绪：基于CGANs和LLMs的情绪引导书籍推荐
articles.abstractCn: 与文本情绪相匹配的背景音乐已被证明能让读者更有沉浸感，提升阅读体验，从而激励推荐系统将书籍与情绪匹配的音乐进行搭配。在此方向上，我们提出了情感感知生成对抗网络用于跨域推荐（SAGA-CDR），这是一个两阶段的跨域推荐框架，能够个性化音乐推荐并使其在情感上与正在阅读的书籍保持一致。在第一阶段，基于Transformer的情感嵌入从用户评论中构建，并通过条件生成对抗网络跨域映射，其掩码条件生成器处理缺失的情感组件，并注入随机性以实现更丰富的偏好迁移。随后，一个紧凑的评分神经网络融合了特定情感交互评分与协同过滤先验，以预测音乐评分。在第二阶段，大型语言模型将每本书分类到效价-唤醒情绪象限中，候选曲目被筛选以匹配该象限。在英文亚马逊和中文豆瓣数据集上的实验表明，SAGA-CDR在亚马逊上实现了最高的评分预测精度（RMSE 0.98），在豆瓣上实现了最低的RMSE（0.91），其排序性能与最强的情感感知基线相当，即使在跨语言环境下也是如此。

articles.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
articles.abstract: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.
articles.titleCn: MedPrune：面向医学问答任务的拓扑高效多模态多智能体通信进化
articles.abstractCn: 医学多模态大型语言模型（Med-MLLMs）推动了医学视觉问答（VQA）的发展，但现有的临床工作流启发式多智能体框架因冗余通信拓扑导致的交互模式与过度计算开销而受限。在本文中，我们提出了MedPrune，一个高效的医学多模态多智能体协作框架，该框架通过动态修剪通信拓扑中的节点和边来增强推理能力和token效率。具体而言，我们首先将诊断过程表述为异构通信图，其中节点代表来自不同科室的专家智能体，边则捕捉部门内与部门间的交互。基于该图，我们引入了两种稀疏化机制以实现自适应协作进化：（1）异构节点稀疏化，通过强化学习驱动的拓扑优化消除与当前多模态问题无关的任务无关专家智能体；（2）异构边稀疏化，通过联合优化任务性能和拓扑复杂度，选择性地保留最具诊断显著性的部门内与部门间连接。在完整集和少样本训练设置下的大量医学VQA实验证明，MedPrune超越了多智能体基线，并显著提升了token效率，同时具备强大的对抗鲁棒性。

articles.title: Programmatic Search Agents: Extending Agentic Search Beyond Query Reformulation
articles.abstract: Search agents adapt their queries, yet fixed search interfaces leave candidate processing and evidence presentation outside the agent's direct control. Our trajectory analysis shows that supporting passages can be retrieved yet never delivered to the agent; a same-page oracle intervention shows that changing the returned evidence can reduce subsequent search. We introduce Programmatic Search Agent (PSA), which makes a local executable computation over candidates the unit of a search action. PSA unifies a persistent candidate workspace, flexible primitive composition, and selective evidence presentation. It incrementally generates program cells that reuse candidates, execute dependent operations, and select what the agent inspects next. The runtime resolves specified data dependencies within each cell, while the agent adapts its search strategy across cells as new evidence arrives. We compare PSA with the Query-based Agent and Tool-based Agent on InfoSeek-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus using five policy backbones without task-specific training. All three interfaces share the search substrate, and the Tool-based Agent also shares PSA's primitives and persistent workspace. Relative to the Query-based Agent, PSA improves macro-averaged task success by 4.00 and 7.56 percentage points on the two benchmarks, respectively; within-backbone reductions in final-step tokens average 28.3% and 33.9%. These results support extending agent control beyond query reformulation to the processing and presentation of retrieved evidence. Code will be released subject to approval.
articles.titleCn: 程序化搜索代理：将代理式搜索扩展至查询重写之外
articles.abstractCn: 搜索代理会调整其查询，但固定的搜索界面将候选处理和证据呈现置于代理的直接控制之外。我们的轨迹分析表明，支持性段落可以被检索却从未交付给代理；同一页面预言干预显示，改变返回的证据可以减少后续搜索。我们引入了程序化搜索代理（PSA），它将候选上的本地可执行计算作为搜索动作的单位。PSA统一了持久候选工作区、灵活的原语组合和选择性证据呈现。它逐个生成程序单元，这些单元重用候选、执行依赖操作并选择代理下一步检查的内容。运行时在每个单元内解析指定的数据依赖关系，而代理跨单元调整其搜索策略，随着新证据的出现。我们在InfoSeek-Eval和BrowseComp-Plus上使用五种策略主干，未经特定任务训练，将PSA与基于查询的代理和基于工具的代理进行比较。这三个界面共享搜索基础，基于工具的代理还共享PSA的原语和持久工作区。相对于基于查询的代理，PSA在两个基准上分别将宏观平均任务成功率提高了4.00和7.56个百分点；最终步骤token的骨干内减少平均为28.3%和33.9%。这些结果支持将代理控制从查询重述扩展到检索证据的处理和呈现。代码将在获得批准后发布。

articles.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
articles.abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
articles.titleCn: 为临床大型语言模型对齐多模态患者证据与生物医学知识图谱
articles.abstractCn: 临床问题通常依赖于将患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识关联起来，然而现有的预测系统很少明确表示这种关联，因此既无法追溯到其证据来源，也无法移除以衡量其贡献。我们提出了MM-KG（多模态知识图谱），它将异构的多模态患者观察结果和生物医学概念表示为同一类型图谱中的不同层，并通过明确的对齐边连接。首先，特定模态的协调器将电子病历文本、影像、基因组学和生物标本数据转换为映射到UMLS概念的类型化观察结果，这些观察结果通过优先路由对齐器链接到生物医学知识图谱。然后，基于查询条件的检索选择一个紧凑的子图，供大型语言模型或图神经网络在下游使用。我们为MIMIC-IV和ADNI构建了MM-KGs，并使用一个将患者证据、生物医学知识和它们之间的交互分开的2x2设计来评估它们。在需要两种来源的问题上，单独的任何一种来源都不远高于偶然，而它们的组合在MIMIC上产生了+0.194的药物控制AUROC交互，在ADNI上产生了+0.299。在保留的五候选排序中，MM-KG在Hits@1上比MindMap高+0.131，并在需要咨询患者的问题上领先于改进的GraphCare，而删除检索包中的单个答案承载关系将Hits@1恢复到无知识基线。最后，基于查询条件的检索在比最强通用策略少6.8倍的上下文中达到了0.731 AUROC，而静态知识图谱上下文在普通结果预测上没有一致的增益。因此，知识图谱通过作为多模态患者证据与问题所需关系之间的明确链接，而不是作为背景上下文，使临床LLM受益，而MM-KG使这些链接变得可检索、可追溯和可测试。

articles.title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
articles.titleCn: 稀疏概率图如何塑造专家混合路由
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）路由器通常对路由分数应用softmax并保留前K个专家，使每个token使用恰好K个专家。稀疏诱导概率图，如sparsemax、alpha-entmax和normmax，可以自适应地将精确的零分配给选定的专家，因此即使使用相同的top-K机制，也似乎提供了token相关的专家参与。在这项工作中，我们研究了这种稀疏性是否以及在何种程度上能够经受住训练。我们使用softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax和2-normmax训练了匹配的300M和1B top-2 MoE语言模型，发现一旦训练完成，这些图的行為差异很大：在1B时，entmax比softmax丢弃了30%更少的概率质量，而几乎从不丢弃选定的专家，sparsemax保留了最多的质量，而normmax将21%的token路由到单个专家。这些结果并非仅是图本身的属性。每个图只在两个最大分数之间的差距达到固定阈值时才会丢弃选定的专家，并且训练好的路由器在学习到的分数分布上有所不同：entmax路由器学习的分数分布的离散程度约为softmax的一半，这使其top-2差距保持在阈值以下，而sparsemax和normmax（共享相同的阈值）学习了不同的差距分布，从而产生了不同的参与度。因此，路由器会与图协同调整分数，而图产生零的能力本身并不能决定专家参与度。虽然这些稀疏图没有一个在验证损失上优于softmax，但它们使训练好的模型在推理时对选择更多专家变得不那么敏感：使用K=2训练的sparsemax在K=8运行时损失0.02 nat，而softmax损失0.58。我们的结果表明，自适应MoE路由的设计必须围绕概率图和学习到的分数的联合行为，而不仅仅是围绕图本身。

articles.title: The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance
articles.abstract: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.
articles.titleCn: 反弹悖论：一种用于语言模型合规性的双探诊法
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型是否遵循用户指令？一个始终服从的模型可以被停止，但也可能被利用；而一个始终抵抗的模型则既不会被利用，也无法被停止。我们贡献了一个开放式的双探针基准，可以将任何语言模型置于这个谱系上。在主动探针中，用户指示模型行动并接受较低的收益，这衡量了其可利用性。在被动探针中，用户指示模型等待并放弃较高的收益，这衡量了其可停止性。这两种服从率结合为服从指数 $κ$。应用于十二个语言模型后，该基准显示七个模型在两种探针中都主要遵循指令，并通过引用指令来为其行为辩护。只有Claude Sonnet-4.6和Claude Opus-4.7既能被停止又不会被利用，Claude Opus-4.6和GPT-5-mini抵抗两种指令，且没有模型是可利用但不可停止的。了解语言模型在服从指数 $κ$ 上的位置，对人类操作员和多智能体系统（无论是否分布式协调）都具有重要意义。

articles.title: Reward Stealing Attack on Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Adversarial attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to induce harmful content. However, existing methods suffer from high computational costs or strict model-pairing dependencies, limiting their scalability and transferability. We propose Reward Stealing Attack (ReSA), an adversarial attack framework that targets the latent safety reward underlying LLM alignment. ReSA employs maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning to recover a proxy reward model solely from the aligned model's behavior. The extracted reward is then reversed at inference time to derive an adversarial policy, efficiently implemented via a reward-guided decoding mechanism. Experiments demonstrate that a single recovered reward generalizes across prompts and diverse models to reveal a fundamental alignment vulnerability, enabling ReSA to significantly outperform existing attacks in effectiveness and transferability. The code is available at https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA.
articles.titleCn: 针对大型语言模型的奖励窃取攻击
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的对抗攻击旨在诱导有害内容。然而，现有方法存在计算成本高或严格的模型对依赖问题，限制了其可扩展性和可迁移性。我们提出了奖励窃取攻击（ReSA），这是一种针对LLM对齐背后潜在安全奖励的对抗攻击框架。ReSA采用最大熵逆强化学习，仅从对齐模型的行为中恢复代理奖励模型。提取的奖励在推理时被反转，以推导出对抗策略，并通过奖励引导解码机制高效实现。实验表明，单个恢复的奖励可以泛化到不同的提示和模型，揭示了对齐中的一个基本漏洞，使得ReSA在有效性和可迁移性方面显著优于现有攻击。代码可在https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA获取。

articles.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
articles.abstract: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.
articles.comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Information included as an appendix; figure source data as ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 语言模型能够识别一个不可能解决的工程问题，但仍然会报告为已解决。
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型可以草拟工程计算，但其回答的准确性并不能体现它们是否拒绝一个不可能的问题。我们对14个模型在30对力学问题（每对问题包含一个有效版本和一个通过改变给定值或假设而变得不可能的版本）上进行了测试。两位独立的求解者验证了每个答案键，并表明每个有缺陷的问题在物理上都是不可能的。我们将有效问题的求解与对其有缺陷对应问题的拒绝分别进行评分。每个回复都需要一个“已解决”或“无法解决”的状态；拒绝意味着“无法解决”或保留答案。初始提示没有警告问题可能是有缺陷的。在三个最近的模型中，90个回复中有12个未能拒绝一个有缺陷的问题。在这11个回复中，人工智能评阅者和数值检查表明，模型指出了缺陷，回答了一个修正后的问题，但仍然将原始问题报告为“已解决”。我们后来重新测试了来自同一供应商的四个模型，提供了“有缺陷”而不是“无法解决”，并要求它们指明并解释缺陷。三个模型显示出统计上显著的拒绝增加，但有缺陷问题的求解在三个模型中有所下降。因此，评估需要同时评分两种版本，并区分缺陷识别与报告状态。

articles.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
articles.abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.
articles.titleCn: 对流动匹配进行潜在推理有何重要意义
articles.abstractCn: 潜在推理使大型语言模型（LLM）能够在连续空间中进行思考，并仅用语言表达答案。我们主张有效的潜在思考必须满足五个要求：它应该是有用的，帮助生成正确答案而不是仅仅改变答案；多样化的，以便重新采样产生不同的推理轨迹；可解释的，以便解码的思维链（CoT）反映答案实际遵循的推理；可改进的，可以通过更多的推理计算进行优化；以及高效的，在同等精度下成本低于显式CoT。当前方法很少满足这些要求：它们从问题中学习捷径，将显式CoT蒸馏到它们的权重中，或逐个token进行模仿。我们专注于在学习的潜在空间中进行流匹配，这是我们认为是最佳满足这些要求的家族，并确定了使其起作用所需的训练选择。结果是流式潜在推理（FLaRe），这是一个简单的配方，涵盖了潜在空间编码的内容以及如何塑造它，在哪里训练流，如何读取答案，以及模型自身验证思考的最终训练阶段。针对每个要求的探针表明，FLaRe在所有五个方面都优于先前的潜在方法。它还在算术基准测试中表现出色，同时达到显式CoT 97%的精度，但延迟只有其四分之一。

articles.title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
articles.abstract: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.
articles.titleCn: 维基数据搜索轨迹：用于训练知识图谱搜索代理的数据集
articles.abstractCn: 维基数据是最大的开放知识库之一，但要在其上回答复杂问题仍需编写命名正确实体和属性并串联其关系的SPARQL查询。语言模型提供了自然语言的替代方案，但主要依赖记忆，对于知名度较低的实体最不可靠。我们研究通过探索图谱来回答问题的智能体，并认为有两个障碍限制了它们：缺乏记录求解器如何探索的训练数据，以及将大量图谱结果直接添加到模型上下文中的接口。我们测试了三个假设：图谱搜索的难度可以通过问题的结构而非仅通过晦涩的实体或措辞来控制；长期搜索中的大部分失败源于检索证据的管理方式而非模型本身；在合适的环境中，开放权重模型可以媲美商业封闭模型。我们在冻结的维基数据快照上构建多跳问题，通过将命名实体替换为嵌套条件，并在每次扩展后检查目标是否保持唯一以及每个新条件是否必要。我们发布了10,235条针对单实体和多跳问题的求解轨迹，以及生成这些轨迹的递归语言模型（RLM）框架，该框架中模型批量调用图谱接口，将结果保存在持久化的Python状态中，并通过子调用解释选定的证据。在100个问题上，该框架与我们直接调用相同功能的两个模型相比，均提升了性能：gpt-6-luna从49个正确答案提升到61个，其多跳准确率翻倍；Qwen3.8-27B（一个在单个GPU上运行的开放权重模型）从60个提升到74个。

articles.title: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型的表示空间最大均值差异
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一种针对扩散语言模型（DLMs）的微调方法，该方法通过最小化冻结预训练DLM特征空间中生成分布与参考分布之间的最大平均差异（MMD）来实现。为估计MMD，我们保留每个标记位置上的上下文特征，通过单个提取器传递从每个序列中获取多个观测值。我们使用策略梯度优化离散模型的目标函数，并通过生成潜空间进行直接微分优化连续模型。在这两种情况下，直接从这些特征计算损失使得无需完整采样轨迹或联合训练辅助模型即可实现高效的微调。实验表明，在OpenWebText上具有可比熵的情况下，生成困惑度更低；在GSM8K上实现了更好的准确率-计算权衡。在具有混合掩码-均匀扩散的16B DMax-LLaDA2.0模型上，我们通过提高解码并行性，在数学和代码基准测试中实现了相似或更高的准确率。

articles.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. Across reasoning tasks, LoGRA reduces average training memory by up to 45.7\% without sacrificing performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{Molt library}.
articles.titleCn: LoGRA：使用低秩梯度草图扩展大型语言模型强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）极大地提升了大型语言模型（LLMs）的能力，但其内存需求仍然是更广泛应用的障碍。我们介绍了LoGRA，这是一种用于RL后训练的方法，通过在低秩梯度草图中保留有用的学习信号来减少内存。这些紧凑的表示支持模型更新和高效的策略同步。为了防止过大的更新破坏学习过程，我们补充了预测-KL步长控制，该方法在应用每个更新前估计策略变化，并相应地调整其幅度。在推理任务中，LoGRA在不牺牲性能的情况下，将平均训练内存降低了高达45.7%。它还使得在单个八GPU节点上对27B参数模型进行超过1100步的稳定训练成为可能，而密集Adam训练则会耗尽内存，这使得先前内存不可行的RL训练变得实际可行。代码可在Molt库的https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra中获取。

articles.title: Long-Horizon Textual World Modeling through Structured Reasoning
articles.abstract: World models must predict how an environment evolves under sequences of actions, enabling agents to compare possible futures and reason about counterfactual actions before acting. Long-horizon prediction is commonly obtained by recursively applying a one-step transition model, but intermediate errors can compound over time. Multi-step dynamics models instead condition on a sequence of future actions and predict their consequences directly, but become harder to learn as horizon grows: the model must track interacting state changes across the trajectory, endpoint supervision provides weak credit assignment, and intermediate predictions can remain plausible while losing information needed for later states. We show that these challenges can be addressed by casting the internal evolution of a multi-step transition as structured reasoning over textual world states: reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of state tracking, a predictive-gain objective rewards the learned state for improving over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead, and intermediate predictive rewards supervise each state along the trajectory. Because these intermediate states are explicit textual representations of the world, they provide semantically meaningful targets that can be inspected, scored, and corrected during training. Across ScienceWorld, Jericho, and CEO-Bench, our approach achieves the strongest average long-horizon performance against recursive and non-recursive baselines that condition directly on raw history, with gains increasing at longer horizons. In a controlled counterfactual study, our model is also the only one with statistically significant sensitivity to future actions.
articles.titleCn: 基于结构化推理的长时序文本世界建模
articles.abstractCn: 世界模型必须预测环境在一系列动作下的演变过程，使智能体能够在行动前比较可能的未来并推理反事实动作。长时程预测通常通过递归应用单步转换模型获得，但中间误差会随时间累积。多步动力学模型则基于未来动作序列进行条件预测，但学习难度随时程增长而增加：模型必须追踪轨迹中交互的状态变化，终点监督提供微弱的信用分配，且中间预测可能保持看似合理但丢失了后续状态所需的信息。我们证明这些挑战可以通过将多步转换的内部演变视为对文本世界状态的推理过程来解决：对稀疏状态变化的推理减轻了状态追踪的负担，预测增益目标奖励学习到的状态以超越基于原始历史的匹配预测器，而中间预测奖励则监督轨迹中的每个状态。由于这些中间状态是世界状态的显式文本表示，它们提供了语义上有意义的靶标，可以在训练过程中进行检查、评分和修正。在ScienceWorld、Jericho和CEO-Bench上，我们的方法在直接基于原始历史的递归和非递归基线中实现了最强的平均长时程性能，且增益在更长的时程下更为显著。在受控反事实研究中，我们的模型也是唯一对未来动作具有统计显著敏感性的模型。

articles.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as "System One" models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier's uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI's batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV's probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna's token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B's. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV's only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities.
articles.comment: 71 pages, 2 figures, 14 tables (including appendices). v2: corrected author order in metadata
articles.titleCn: JEV与LLMs：七项政治科学重复研究中的准确性、成本和校准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过生成文本标记来标注和扩展政治文本或结构。TypeSafe公司将其新类别模型称为"系统一"模型，这类模型会返回用户提供的固定答案集中的决策和概率分布。商业化模型JEV被宣传具有比传统LLMs更显著的成本和速度优势，以及更精确校准的决策。因此，它可能适用于希望快速、低成本地标注或扩展大量文本库，并需要可靠分类器不确定性指标的社会科学家。然而，这些主张的准确性以及模型在社会科学文本任务中的整体准确性尚未得到证实。在本文中，我们正是进行了这样的研究，并希望确立JEV适用于社会科学任务的可行性。我们将JEV与已发表研究中的LLMs和人类编码员进行比较，并与当前中档商业化LLMs（GPT-6 Luna）和开放权重替代方案（Qwen3.8-27B）进行对比。我们发现，在多种任务中，JEV的表现与LLMs相当或接近。然而，我们在OpenAI的批量价格下并未发现JEV相较于GPT-6 Luna的成本优势。此外，我们发现，当每个问题只被问一次时，JEV的概率校准优于GPT-6 Luna的标记概率，但并不始终优于Qwen3.8-27B的概率。我们得出结论，除非研究人员有对速度的需求，JEV的唯一明显优势在于更容易解析其基础选择概率。

articles.title: Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? Disentangling Two Choices in Low-Rank LoRA
articles.abstract: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A or output factor B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task-model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8-18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT's MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.
articles.titleCn: 冻结因子还是频谱带？低秩LoRA中的两种选择解耦
articles.abstractCn: 低秩自适应（LoRA）的谱变体同时选择子空间和冻结因子。我们将这些选择分开，通过冻结预训练权重的高维或低维方向上的输入因子A或输出因子B，并分别选择学习率。在秩为2时，冻结A的同一频段优势在所有四个具有完整比较的任务-模型对中均大于任何因子内频段差异。冻结B在跨越格式化任务和OpenBookQA的五个对中，也比同等预算的LoRA落后8-18个百分点。冻结A的优势在单GPU模型复现和单个MLP模块组中依然存在，包括B冻结且可训练计数相等或更多的对照组，以及A在随机正交基上冻结时。因子对比随着秩的降低而减弱。在OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B的秩16下，PEFT的MiCA实现在使用从MiCA论文转移的共同训练配方时，比同等预算的LoRA落后3.08个百分点。训练后的神谕输出子空间基本消除了低秩劣势；在三个方向种子中重复出现部分预热收益。因子与频段的顺序是描述性的；一个近似的倍数审核削弱了几个早期的显著性主张。这些结果通过展示其幅度如何依赖于谱位置、秩和训练条件，扩展了已知的因子不对称性。

articles.title: COMPASS 2.0: psychometric representational similarity analysis distinguishes symptom structure from personal signal
articles.abstract: Language models can score psychiatric questionnaires from speech, but agreement with self-report may reflect the questionnaire rather than the person. We introduce psychometric representational similarity analysis, a framework for comparing the structure of speech-derived scores, self-report, item wording and theory, and implement it alongside person-level construct scoring in COMPASS 2.0. We show how similarly worded items induce covariance without psychological signal. In pre-registered discovery and confirmation analyses of clinical interviews from 275 participants, language-derived symptom geometry resembled wording more than self-report, with no structure beyond wording detected by the registered tests. Geometric agreement with self-report survived assigning participants someone else's answers, whereas person-paired scores captured distress more than specific symptoms. Complementary analyses examined counselling quality and wording structure across 34 instruments and the Research Domain Criteria (RDoC) framework. These findings distinguish agreement about psychological structure from evidence that language-derived assessments track individual people.
articles.comment: 28 pages, including Extended Data and Supplementary Information. Code for reproducibility: https://github.com/linlab/xpsych
articles.titleCn: COMPASS 2.0：心理测量学表征相似性分析区分了症状结构与个人信号
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型可以从语音中评分精神病学问卷，但与自我报告的一致性可能反映的是问卷本身而非个人。我们引入了心理测量代表性相似性分析，这是一个用于比较语音衍生评分、自我报告、项目措辞和理论的结构的框架，并在COMPASS 2.0中实现了与个人层面构念评分相结合。我们展示了措辞相似的项目如何在没有心理信号的情况下诱导共变。在对275名参与者的临床访谈的预先注册发现和确认分析中，语言衍生的症状几何形状比自我报告更接近措辞，注册测试未检测到措辞之外的任何结构。与自我报告的几何一致性在分配参与者他人的答案时仍然存在，而个人配对评分比特定症状更能捕捉到痛苦。补充分析检查了34种工具和RDoC框架中的咨询质量和措辞结构。这些发现区分了关于心理结构的一致性，以及语言衍生评估跟踪个人的证据。

articles.title: Word-Level Text Unmixing via Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing with Language Models
articles.abstract: Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams. We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing: given an interleaved lexical stream and source count K, recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly. Directly generating separated texts with LLMs can omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating this exact-reconstruction objective. We therefore propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR), which decouples source-ownership prediction from reconstruction. EPOR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the mixed stream and prior routing decisions. At inference, completion-safe constrained decoding is combined with deterministic indexed reconstruction, yielding structurally valid K-source partitions that preserve every observed occurrence exactly once. We also introduce UNMIXBENCH, covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs. Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPOR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and remaining competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs. These results show that when lexical evidence is fully observed, separating ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct generation.
articles.titleCn: 基于语言模型的证据保留所有权路由的词级文本去混合
articles.abstractCn: 当归属元数据丢失时，来自多个来源的文本可能会交织成一个单一序列，例如重叠的语音转录、文档阅读流或并发代理流。我们将这一挑战形式化为词级文本分离：给定一个交织的词汇流和来源计数K，恢复原始来源序列，同时精确保留每个词的出现及其在来源内的顺序。直接使用大型语言模型生成分离文本可能会遗漏、重复或凭空捏造词语，违背精确重建目标。因此，我们提出了证据保留所有权路由（EPOR），将来源所有权预测与重建过程解耦。EPOR将因果型大型语言模型应用于根据混合流和先前的路由决策预测规范所有权路径。在推理阶段，结合安全约束解码和确定性索引重建，生成结构有效的K来源分区，精确保留每个观察到的出现一次。我们还引入了UNMIXBENCH，涵盖受控合成混合、来自AMI和ICSI的时间戳语音、来自ReadingBank的布局衍生文档流以及模拟的并发数字输出。在五个评估轨道中，4B EPOR模型在微调基线中实现了最低的每词最小排列错误率，相较于紧凑来源数组生成降低了22.3%的相对误差，并保持与零样本前沿大型语言模型的竞争力。这些结果表明，当词汇证据完全被观察到时，将所有权推理与词汇再生分离提供了一种可靠的替代直接生成的方法。

articles.title: Molecules of a Story: Community Detection in PMI-weighted Narrative Networks
articles.abstract: Automatically extracted narrative networks -- graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges -- have proven useful for revealing central narrative structures through salient entities and their connections (Tangherlini et al. 2020; Labatut and Bost 2019). But a narrative is more than those central structures that everything else revolves around. This work is concerned with the everything else: brief sub-plots, small clusters of descriptions, or associations between minor characters that go under the radar at the macro-level. We present an approach to unearth such peripheral structures. They involve rare entities with limited textual presence, overshadowed by dominant entities and lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities (Baayen 2001). We leverage the known tendency of pointwise mutual information (PMI, Church and Hanks 1990) to inflate for rare events, turning its weakness into a strength by weighting edges with PMI to foreground peripheral entity configurations. Communities extracted from the resulting network are structural traces of underlying narrative elements. We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings. From measures of how concentrated or dispersed a community's activations are across the text, a typology emerges that reveals that peripheral structures form more than a single class: episodic passages, echoing long-distance connections, and recurring threads each surface as distinct configurations. The approach is conceptually simple and surfaces fine-grained narrative details that are lost in abundance, though its deliberate amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity -- best understood as a lens for exploration rather than a robust extraction pipeline.
articles.titleCn: 故事分子：PMI加权叙事网络中的社区检测
articles.abstractCn: 自动提取的叙事网络——以实体为节点、关系为边构建的图——已被证明可通过显著实体及其连接揭示核心叙事结构（Tangherlini等人，2020；Labatut和Bost，2019）。但叙事远不止于那些围绕其展开的核心结构。本研究关注的是“其他一切”：简短的次级情节、小规模的描述集群，或宏观层面不易察觉的次要角色之间的关联。我们提出了一种挖掘此类边缘结构的方法。这些结构涉及文本中出现频率较低的实体，它们被主导实体所掩盖，并在众多罕见实体构成的“长尾”中彼此迷失（Baayen，2001）。我们利用点互信息（PMI，Church和Hanks，1990）已知对罕见事件有放大效应的倾向，通过以PMI对边进行加权，将这一弱点转化为优势，从而突出边缘实体配置。从生成的网络中提取出的社区是底层叙事元素的 结构性痕迹。我们在《指环王》上验证了该方法。通过衡量社区在文本中的激活集中或分散程度，形成了一种类型学，揭示边缘结构并非单一类别：情节段落、回响长距离连接的片段以及反复出现的线索，各自呈现出不同的配置。该方法概念上简单，揭示了在大量信息中被忽略的细粒度叙事细节，尽管其刻意放大弱信号的特性带来了固有的敏感性——最好将其理解为探索的视角而非稳健的提取流程。

articles.title: Mind the Accent Gap: British Accent Robustness in Speech-Driven Financial Voice Assistants
articles.abstract: AI voice assistants often use Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with LLM-based reasoning, yet existing systems struggle with regional British accents, including Scottish, Irish, and Welsh accents, since most ASR models are trained predominantly on American English voice data. Consequently, errors can carry through to the LLM stage, corrupting tool-call arguments and producing wrong or missing responses, which is especially costly in finance. Deployable ASR must also meet tight latency and memory budgets, making an accent-robust model choice even harder. We introduce CavaBench, the first internally collected benchmark of spoken financial queries, and use it to evaluate a range of ASR models and their end-to-end ASR-LLM pipeline behaviour across self-reported British accents. We find that WER strongly predicts downstream tool-calling accuracy ($r = -0.93$) but can fail to reflect task-level performance, with accent-related failures varying substantially across models and acoustic conditions. These findings guide the design of more inclusive, reliable voice-based financial assistants.
articles.titleCn: 注意口音差异：语音驱动型金融语音助手中的英式口音鲁棒性
articles.abstractCn: AI语音助手通常使用基于LLM的推理与自动语音识别（ASR）技术，但现有系统在处理英国地区口音（包括苏格兰、爱尔兰和威尔士口音）时存在困难，因为大多数ASR模型主要基于美式英语语音数据进行训练。因此，错误会传递到LLM阶段，导致工具调用参数损坏，产生错误或缺失的响应，这在金融领域尤其昂贵。可部署的ASR系统还必须满足严格的延迟和内存预算要求，这使得选择具有口音鲁棒性的模型更加困难。我们介绍了CavaBench，这是首个内部收集的关于金融语音查询的基准，并使用它评估了一系列ASR模型及其端到端ASR-LLM流程在自报英国口音下的表现。我们发现，词错误率（WER）强烈预测了下游工具调用的准确性（$r = -0.93$），但可能无法反映任务层面的性能，不同模型和声学条件下的口音相关错误差异很大。这些发现为设计更具包容性和可靠性的基于语音的金融助手提供了指导。

articles.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
articles.abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.
articles.titleCn: 注意执行差距：世界模型控制中的动作-语义不匹配
articles.abstractCn: 世界模型控制器依赖动作条件动力学进行预测和规划，但实际控制系统由于通信延迟、数据包丢失、重排序和执行器缓冲等原因，通常异步执行指令。我们研究异步执行如何改变世界模型控制器内部假设的动作语义，而不是将其仅视为外部控制干扰。通过受控干预，我们识别出两种与架构相关的失效模式：基于规划的控制器（如TD-MPC2）在想象的动作序列与执行的动作序列之间存在未来动作时间线不匹配的问题，而循环世界模型（如DreamerV3）则可能将观察到的状态转换归因于未实际应用的指令。我们的分析表明，TD-MPC2需要在潜在动力学展开过程中获得正确的未来动作序列，而DreamerV3需要及时地将每个状态转换归因于生成它的动作。基于这些发现，我们引入了两种轻量级的执行一致性接口：用于TD-MPC2的未来序列接口和用于DreamerV3的应用动作反馈接口，这些接口在不修改预训练世界模型的情况下修正了这些不匹配问题。在延迟、数据包丢失、重排序、多控制域、实测网络轨迹以及进程隔离的异步栈上的实验结果始终支持这两种诊断及其对应的架构特定修正。

articles.title: Before Agent Tells The Lie: Has Deception Already Been Represented?
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents can exhibit deceptive behavior during task execution, including hiding failures, fabricating results, or falsely signaling task completion. Existing monitoring approaches mainly detect deception after it appears in observable actions or outputs. In this paper, we investigate whether deceptive behavior can be predicted from an agent's internal representations before it becomes externally visible. We frame deception monitoring as a trajectory-level representation analysis problem and align agent trajectories around key decision points. Using hidden states extracted before these points, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes can be reliably distinguished, with predictive signals remaining detectable several model calls before the final decision. We further characterize the temporal evolution of these signals: deception-related representations are weak early in execution but become increasingly identifiable as trajectories progress, while transferable structure can emerge before the strongest decision-adjacent signals appear. Finally, we intervene on the identified honest-deceptive representation directions during inference and find that activation steering reduces downstream deceptive behavior, suggesting that these representations influence agent decisions. Our findings indicate that agent deception is an evolving internal process that can be detected and potentially mitigated before it is expressed externally.
articles.titleCn: 在代理说谎之前：欺骗是否已经被表现？
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在执行任务时可能表现出欺骗行为，包括隐藏失败、编造结果或虚假标记任务完成。现有的监控方法主要在欺骗行为出现在可观察的动作或输出后进行检测。在本文中，我们研究了是否能在欺骗行为在外部可见之前，从智能体的内部表征中预测出这种行为。我们将欺骗监控问题框架化为轨迹级别的表征分析问题，并将智能体的轨迹围绕关键决策点进行对齐。利用在这些点之前提取的隐藏状态，我们展示了未来诚实和欺骗结果可以被可靠地区分，且预测信号在最终决策之前的多次模型调用中仍然可检测。我们进一步刻画了这些信号的时序演化：与欺骗相关的表征在执行初期较弱，但随着轨迹的推进变得越来越可识别，而可迁移结构则可能在最强决策相邻信号出现之前就已出现。最后，我们在识别出的诚实-欺骗表征方向上进行推理干预，发现激活引导减少了下游的欺骗行为，表明这些表征影响了智能体的决策。我们的研究表明，智能体的欺骗是一个演变的内部过程，可以在其外部表达之前被检测到并可能被缓解。

articles.title: Synthetic Cultural Agents from Aggregate Anchors
articles.abstract: Population prompts are widely used to generate synthetic survey responses, but they combine information supplied at inference with associations already encoded during pretraining. We introduce an alternative construction that maps declared aggregate preference anchors into group-indexed choice policies. For each population, the signs of six Global Preferences Survey (GPS) coordinates deterministically label a shared bank of paired synthetic responses, and Direct Preference Optimization fits a parameter-efficient adapter to those comparisons. We evaluate the adapters on candidate World Values Survey (WVS) items using prompts that omit country names and distinguish four questions: recovery of the imposed labels, transfer of the anchor signal to new text, coherence between the GPS anchors and human WVS responses, and agreement between adapter and human scores. The adapters recover the imposed pairwise labels. On a purposively selected sixteen-country development panel, adapter trust scores completely separate the two GPS-sign groups and have a rank correlation of (0.74) with continuous GPS trust scores. Human-GPS and adapter-human associations remain unresolved on the same panel, and results for the other preference dimensions are heterogeneous. These findings show that an anchored policy can retain a declared aggregate signal without thereby reproducing human response patterns. The contribution is therefore both an inspectable construction and an evaluation framework that separates anchor transfer from human criterion agreement.
articles.titleCn: 基于聚合锚点的合成文化代理
articles.abstractCn: 人口提示被广泛用于生成合成调查回复，但它们结合了推理时提供的信息与预训练期间已编码的关联。我们引入了一种替代性构建方法，将声明的聚合偏好锚点映射到分组索引的选择策略。对于每个群体，六个全球偏好调查（GPS）坐标的符号会确定性地标记一个共享的成对合成回复库，直接偏好优化则为这些比较拟合一个参数高效的适配器。我们在使用省略国家名称的提示下，评估了适配器在候选世界价值观调查（WVS）项目上的表现，并区分了四个问题：恢复强加的标签、将锚点信号转移到新文本、GPS锚点与人类WVS回复之间的连贯性，以及适配器与人类评分之间的协议。适配器恢复了强加的成对标签。在一个有目的地选择的十六国发展面板上，适配器信任评分完全区分了两个GPS符号组，并与连续GPS信任评分具有（0.74）的等级相关性。在同一个面板上，人类-GPS和适配器-人类关联仍未解决，其他偏好维度的结果具有异质性。这些发现表明，一个锚定策略可以在不因此复制人类回复模式的情况下保留声明的聚合信号。因此，这项贡献既是一种可检查的构建方法，也是一种将锚点转移与人类标准协议分离的评价框架。

articles.title: JudgeMoE: Distributional Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge
articles.abstract: When an LLM judge scores an output, its score distribution retains uncertainty and disagreement information that is lost after scalar compression. We introduce JudgeMoE, a lightweight aggregator that assigns example-specific weights to cached judge score distributions and fuses them before computing a final score. A protocol study shows that score-range choice is unstable across judge--dataset settings and that soft scoring usually outperforms hard decoding. On the original 10-cell benchmark, JudgeMoE improves mean Spearman over uniform log pooling by $+0.079$. Applying the same configuration to six additional cells yields a $+0.0393$ mean gain over the strongest local single judge across 16 cells, with positive differences in 12/16 cells and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank $p=0.0091$. Validation-based analyses further show that the preferred aggregation method depends on the task and judge pool.
articles.titleCn: JudgeMoE：用于作为评判者的LLM的分布式聚合
articles.abstractCn: 当大型语言模型（LLM）裁判对输出进行评分时，其评分分布保留了标量压缩后会丢失的不确定性和分歧信息。我们引入了JudgeMoE，这是一种轻量级聚合器，它为缓存的裁判评分分布分配特定于示例的权重，并在计算最终分数之前将它们融合。一项协议研究表明，评分范围选择在不同裁判—数据集设置中是不稳定的，而软评分通常优于硬解码。在原始的10单元基准测试中，JudgeMoE比均匀对数池化提高了平均Spearman等级+$0.079$。将相同的配置应用于另外六个单元，相较于16个单元中最强的本地单一裁判，平均增益为+$0.0393$，在16个单元中的12个单元存在正向差异，单边Wilcoxon符号秩检验$p=0.0091$。基于验证的分析进一步表明，首选的聚合方法取决于任务和裁判池。

articles.title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
articles.abstract: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.
articles.titleCn: LLM谄媚的解剖：翻转率隐藏了什么
articles.abstractCn: 在受到反驳的情况下，模型可以自我纠正、屈服或坚持，而一次翻转率既计为纠正也计为屈服。使用SycoLens，一个模块化重放协议，我们测试了用户压力和评估设置如何影响测量的翻转率。每次测量都是对一项物品、一个已提交的答案以及一个固定格式中的脚本用户行的无状态重放。每个效果都通过与删除该行匹配的控制组进行对比来读取。反驳措辞、已提交文本、答案格式、边界距离和真实情况成为同一仪器的因素；早期的仪器变化其中一到三个因素。在来自三家供应商的十一个前沿模型和大约760,000次受控重放中，哪些模型显得奉承取决于用户如何进行反驳。断言相反结论的行和挑战答案但不断言结论的行对模型的排名几乎无关。翻转效果在模型边界附近增长数倍，但在所有筛选中都相同回答的物品仍然大约占受影响总量的一半。在真实情况已知的算术任务中，一个模型在压力下重新推导并自我纠正，而另一个则放弃正确答案且无书面工作。在测试的模型中，植入的推导会降低其支持答案（无论对错）的释放，而单纯陈述的值则不会；错误答案被纠正的频率远高于正确答案被放弃的频率。在是/否读取下，排名更加接近，与压力引起的向“否”的倾向交织在一起。因此，每个模型一个分数用于比较不同模型和基准的行为。我们将这些依赖关系浓缩为一份报告配置文件；仪器、记录和分析将在发表时公开。

articles.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Reasoning Strategies with Bayesian Nonparametric Memory
articles.abstract: While modern large language models (LLMs) have been trained to reason through verbalized chains-of-thought, the generation cost grows substantially due to suboptimal paths to reach the final answer. Furthermore, as new insights are discovered while observing various input queries (e.g. through self-reflection), limited mechanisms exist for carrying forward these findings to be applied to subsequent problems. One can view the list of such strategies or behaviors as a growing cheatsheet, with elements retrieved from this memory module at inference-time. In this work, we consider structured cheatsheets, with learned clusters of behaviors. We introduce a Hierarchical Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model (HDP-GMM) over behavior embeddings, which shares components across domains while allowing domain-specific mixing weights, and uses the posterior predictive to retrieve relevant behaviors for a query; we call this a $\textit{Bayesian Cheatsheet}$. This mechanism allows for cheap adaptation in an online test-time training (TTT) setting, softly updating the mixture's sufficient statistics following each sample and enabling the creation of new components when the synthesized behaviors are sufficiently novel. We demonstrate that Bayesian Cheatsheet achieves clear performance gains relative to existing memory modules across reasoning benchmarks such as AIME'25, Omni-MATH, and PhysReason, even in the cold-start setting. We show that the Bayesian Cheatsheet is an adaptively reorganizing memory module, as behaviors can be re-assigned to components through a single step of collapsed Gibbs sampling. Our findings highlight the value of Bayesian-inspired memory modules for effective test-time adaptation and the role of structure in metacognitive reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 基于贝叶斯非参数记忆的推理策略的测试时适应
articles.abstractCn: 尽管现代大型语言模型（LLM）已通过口头思维链进行推理训练，但由于到达最终答案的路径次优，生成成本显著增加。此外，在观察各种输入查询（例如通过自我反思）时发现新见解，但存在有限的机制将这些发现传递并应用于后续问题。可以将此类策略或行为列表视为不断增长的“作弊表”，在推理时从该记忆模块中检索元素。在本工作中，我们考虑结构化的作弊表，包含学习到的行为簇。我们引入了一个行为嵌入上的层次狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（HDP-GMM），该模型在领域间共享组件，同时允许领域特定的混合权重，并使用后验预测来检索与查询相关的行为；我们称之为“贝叶斯作弊表”。该机制允许在在线测试时训练（TTT）设置中进行廉价适应，在每次样本后软更新混合的充分统计量，并在合成行为足够新颖时创建新组件。我们证明，贝叶斯作弊表相对于现有的记忆模块在AIME'25、Omni-MATH和PhysReason等推理基准测试中实现了明显的性能提升，即使在冷启动设置下也是如此。我们表明，贝叶斯作弊表是一个自适应重组的记忆模块，因为行为可以通过一次折叠吉布斯采样重新分配到组件中。我们的研究突出了受贝叶斯启发的记忆模块在有效测试时适应方面的价值，以及结构在元认知推理中的作用。

articles.title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
articles.abstract: Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL, a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.
articles.titleCn: SOL：通过双重切片Wasserstein度量测量文本分布之间的差距
articles.abstractCn: 评估文本生成需要衡量生成的分布与数据分布的匹配程度。对于自回归模型，这是通过困惑度来完成的。扩散模型和流式语言模型只能提供似然界，而不同模型家族的界紧密度不同。基于样本的替代方法，如使用熵的生成困惑度，并不考虑分布的拟合情况。我们提出了SOL，一种文本分布之间的距离度量。每个序列由其在固定Transformer下的隐藏状态的经验测度表示，并通过双重切片Wasserstein距离比较这些测度的分布。我们证明了如果Transformer是单射的，SOL是一种度量。实验表明，SOL能够检测分布失效，恢复预期的模型趋势，并提供稳定的基于样本的估计。我们提出SOL来填补当前非自回归模型评估协议中的空白。作为第一步，我们使用SOL重新评估了在OpenWebText上训练的各种模型。

articles.title: AECP: Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol for Multi-Agent Code Generation
articles.abstract: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.
articles.titleCn: AECP：多智能体代码生成用文物专属通信协议
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能代理越来越多地处理复杂的仓库级编码任务，跨多个代理分配工作是一种自然的方式，以扩展单个代理的能力。为了协调他们之间相互依赖的工作，这些代理共享发现并就模块之间的接口达成一致。然而，交换的信息通常仅作为背景信息，迫使单个代理对其进行解释并将其纳入后续工作。因此，共享的发现可能未被使用，接口协议的偏离可能未被检测到，从而削弱了协作的可靠性和效率。这促使我们将部分协调责任从单个代理转移到执行框架。为了在执行过程中使共享信息具有可操作性，我们引入了“工件专有通信协议”（AECP）。AECP要求代理必须通过结构化工件进行通信，并规定了框架如何处理这些工件。框架在代理访问相关代码时提供发现，筛选实现与记录的接口承诺之间的不匹配，并要求受影响的代理重新审视修订后的协议。这些协调步骤成为框架执行的一部分，而不是代理必须从先前的消息中发起的动作。在Doc2Repo、NL2Repo和CodeProjectEval等任务中，使用包括Opus-4.8和DeepSeek-V4-Flash在内的闭源和开源模型，AECP将平均测试通过率提高了28.2%，并将平均墙时减少了16.5%，相较于使用自由形式代理间消息的代理团队。工件专有通信还阻止了恶意指令在代理之间的中继，将它们传递给其他代理的频率从95%降至0%，以及这些代理执行它们的频率从40%降至0%。

articles.title: Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: KV caches are a major bottleneck in long-context inference and long-form generation with large language models. Existing training-free eviction policies largely rely on proxy importance signals, such as attention mass, to decide which past tokens to retain. We argue that cache compression should instead preserve the predictive behavior of the full-cache model, retaining entries whose removal would substantially change the model's output distribution. We propose Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression, a training-free framework that scores candidate evictions by estimating the compressed-cache logits induced by their removal and evaluating the resulting KL to the full-cache next-token distribution. Using pre-eviction forward statistics, the method avoids running separate masked forward passes for each candidate. Across diverse architectures and both prefill-time and generation-time compression, our method delivers substantial gains in downstream task quality over lightweight attention-based heuristics at matched retained-KV budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. It achieves these gains with additional compression-time computation while retaining an end-to-end speedup over full-cache inference in our evaluated settings.
articles.titleCn: 行为保持型键值缓存压缩
articles.abstractCn: KV缓存是大型语言模型在长上下文推理和长文本生成中的主要瓶颈。现有的无训练驱逐策略主要依赖代理重要性信号，如注意力质量，来决定保留哪些过去的token。我们认为，缓存压缩应该保留全缓存模型的预测行为，保留那些移除会显著改变模型输出分布的条目。我们提出了行为保留型KV缓存压缩（Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression），这是一个无训练框架，通过估计候选驱逐引起的压缩缓存logits，并评估其产生的KL散度与全缓存下一个token分布，来对候选驱逐进行评分。利用预驱逐前向统计信息，该方法避免了为每个候选运行单独的掩码前向传递。在我们的方法中，跨多种架构以及预填充时间和生成时间压缩，在匹配的保留KV预算下，相较于轻量级的基于注意力的启发式算法，我们的方法在下游任务质量上实现了显著提升，尤其是在激进压缩下效果最为显著。该方法在压缩时间上增加了额外的计算量，但在我们评估的设置中，仍保持了相较于全缓存推理的端到端加速。

articles.title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.
articles.titleCn: 协助困境：通过多轮强化学习学习教学
articles.abstractCn: 用于回答问题的语言模型（LLMs）在教学中天生表现不佳。通过与模拟学生进行强化学习（RL）是提升其教学能力的一种有前景的方法，但现有的RL训练导师在辅导问题的过程中，学生的成功仍然与导师的语境相关。这种情况下，最容易提高奖励的方式是直接告诉学生答案，而需要调整惩罚来减少这种行为。借鉴学习科学，我们引入了一种掩码近迁移后测：学生在导师话语被遮盖的情况下，接受一个未见过的问题变体的测试，因此奖励只能通过学生在自己回合中的回答来提高。这可以减少学生的认知卸载，并允许用两个二元奖励门（导师回答的事实正确性，不转交解决方案）替代持续惩罚。留一法消融实验表明，仅靠学习增益奖励并不能区分教学与告知：门限制了解决方案转交，而近迁移后测则提升了跨领域迁移能力。利用这些奖励设计，我们开发了Eduardo，一个用于训练LLM导师的多回合RL配方，并用它训练了4B、9B、14B和27B来自两个不同LLM架构的模型。我们的后训练Eduardo-27B模型在MathTutorBench上与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当，在TutorMoments上与Claude Opus 4.8相当，且比前沿模型少用2.4-6.2倍的思考token，这对交互式辅导至关重要。在奖励机制中未被提及，模型的“推动证明”教师动作使用量超过翻倍，而支持性减弱（例如，分配独立作业）的行为，其回报超出了单一问题对话回合，被训练消除。我们开源了我们的训练环境、一个包含8,671个问题的近迁移数据集以及训练好的模型，以供进一步开发。

articles.title: Better Call Reward: Reward Hacking as Strategic Abstention in Legal Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: What happens when a legal AI model learns to look like a lawyer instead of reasoning like one? We fine tune Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) against a proxy built from three surface features: citation count, legalese density, and response length. The model does not learn to reason more effectively. It learns to withhold commitment. Across 16 yes or no legal reasoning tasks from LegalBench (N=320), overall accuracy collapses from 0.500 (chance) to 0.072 (McNemar p < 10^-36), driven entirely by the rate of properly formatted answers falling from 0.900 to 0.109. The model stops committing to answers. Yet when it does commit, accuracy rises from 0.556 to 0.657, showing that the collapse is not a failure of capability but a strategic response: the model has learned that verbose responses packed with citations but empty of a direct answer score higher than terse correct ones. We term this the Saul Goodman effect, a policy that becomes maximally lawyerly while becoming maximally noncommittal, and prove formally that it is the optimal response to any surface feature proxy that attaches no penalty to abstention. We further show that 89.3% of citations produced after training are structurally implausible hallucinations, many of them subtly corrupted names of real landmark cases, constructed in effect to survive a casual read and fail under scrutiny. To detect this failure mode before deployment, we introduce three diagnostic tools: the Confidence Theater Score (CTS), the Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR), and the Regret Gap (RG). In a domain where a confidently wrong answer can constitute malpractice, the broader lesson is direct: a reward function that measures how legal a response looks will produce a model that is maximally photogenic and minimally useful.
articles.comment: 11 Pages , Accepted at AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026 also accepted for publication in the Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR)
articles.titleCn: 更好的奖励调用：在法律推理模型中将奖励黑客行为视为策略性放弃
articles.abstractCn: 当法律AI模型学会模仿律师而非像律师一样推理时会发生什么？我们使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）对Qwen3-8B进行微调，构建了一个由三个表面特征组成的代理模型：引用次数、法律术语密度和响应长度。该模型并没有学会更有效地推理。它学会了回避承诺。在LegalBench的16个是或否法律推理任务中（N=320），整体准确率从0.500（随机概率）骤降至0.072（McNemar p < 10^-36），完全由正确格式化答案的比例从0.900降至0.109驱动。该模型停止对答案做出承诺。然而，当它确实做出承诺时，准确率从0.556升至0.657，表明这种骤降并非能力缺陷，而是一种策略性反应：模型学会了包含大量引用但缺乏直接答案的冗长响应，其得分高于简洁正确的响应。我们将此现象称为“索尔·古德曼效应”，即一种在最大化律师风格的同时最大化不承诺的策略，并正式证明这是对任何不惩罚回避行为的表面特征代理模型的最优响应。我们进一步发现，训练后产生的89.3%的引用在结构上是不合理的幻觉，其中许多是真实里程碑案例的微妙错误名称，这些名称被构建得足以在随意阅读时存活，但在审查下失效。为了在部署前检测这种失效模式，我们引入了三种诊断工具：置信度剧院评分（CTS）、引用可信度率（CPR）和后悔差距（RG）。在一个自信的错误答案可能构成过失的领域，更广泛的教训是直接的：一个衡量响应看起来多么像法律文本的奖励函数，将产生一个外观极好但实用性极低的模型。

articles.title: HeuFouFT: Task-Guided Metaheuristic Coordinate Search for Fourier Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: We introduce Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning (HeuFouFT), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available.
articles.titleCn: HeuFouFT：任务引导元启发式坐标搜索用于傅里叶微调
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了启发式引导傅里叶微调（HeuFouFT），这是一个任务引导的框架，用于在傅里叶微调中选择可训练的频率坐标。现有的均匀和高斯带通方案通过固定的、与任务无关的规则分配有限的频谱预算。HeuFouFT则通过下游性能搜索坐标。一个轻量级的块级探针生成的粗略强度图初始化了三种元启发式优化器：模拟退火遗传算法（GA-SA）、粒子群优化（PSO）和布谷鸟搜索（CS）。在搜索过程中，随机森林过滤每个种群，使得只有前30%的候选者进入代理微调。在端到端（E2E）与GPT-2-Medium的实验中，这三种变体在五个指标上均优于随机均匀傅里叶FT、高斯带通傅里叶FT和LoRA。PSO在四个指标上进一步优于性能最佳的基线LoCA，同时使用的可训练频谱系数减少了37.6%。一旦坐标被选定，HeuFouFT仅需全FT（Full FT）15--18%的FLOPs。这些结果表明，任务引导搜索比固定采样更有效地分配有限的频谱能力。我们的代码是公开可用的。

articles.title: Do Speech Representations Preserve Regional Accent Across Read and Spontaneous Speech?
articles.abstract: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read--spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.
articles.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
articles.titleCn: 语音表征是否在朗读和自发性语音中保留地域口音？
articles.abstractCn: 在匹配条件下，地域口音特征可以被捕捉，但它们是否在朗读和自发语音之间持续存在仍不明确。我们研究了RVG1，包含来自九个地区的500名德语说话人，在匹配条件下和说话人无关的朗读-自发迁移下，比较了十种语音表征在地域分类和连续地理定位上的表现。Whisper在匹配条件下表现最佳，达到0.489九向UAR和148公里中值地理定位误差，但在迁移方向上降至0.11/0.18 UAR和363公里地理定位误差。自监督模型显示出类似的退化，而说话人嵌入在领域内区分度较低但在迁移中更稳健。这种对比在分类和地理定位中均保持一致。在所有表征中，稳健性与其在风格间变化程度（风格不变性）相关，跨风格说话人检索是可解释的替代指标。年龄、性别、句子重叠和持续时间控制无法解释这一差距，尽管信道特征有所贡献。这些结果表明，匹配条件下的优异表现并不代表稳健的地域信息。

articles.title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
articles.abstract: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.
articles.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR), NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages (8 main), 9 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark
articles.titleCn: SpatialChain：用于评估VLMs中空间推理忠实度的基准
articles.abstractCn: 具备推理能力的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空间基准测试中不断报告更高的准确率，但最终答案分数无法揭示一个正确预测是否反映了忠实的空间推理或语言捷径。我们引入了SpatialChain数据集，包含28,350个训练样本和899个测试样本，将面向空间的GQA问题与场景图基础的推理链配对，仅保留生成答案与符号化真实值匹配的样本，并采用双轴评估，结合客观链重叠指标与场景图感知的大型语言模型裁判，独立于最终答案对忠实性和完整性进行评分。应用于九个具备推理能力的VLMs后，该协议揭示了标准准确率无法显现的三个发现：(i) 九个模型中有四个实现了≥79%的VQA准确率，但表现出高于39%的捷径率，即裁判判定推理不忠实的正确答案；(ii) 对于九个模型中的七个，链质量显著预测了答案正确性，但两个例外（Claude Sonnet 4.6和InternVL3.5-8B）揭示了本质上不同的失效模式，即简洁输出与冗长装饰性推理，而基准准确率会混淆这两种模式；(iii) 在SpatialChain上的SFT提升了Qwen3-VL-8B的领域内准确率+6.2 pp，并将其捷径率降至22%，而对外部基准测试产生的风格专业化效应则促使采用重放增强训练作为缓解措施。忠实性裁判在198个人工标注样本上得到验证，裁判与人类标注的一致性匹配人类与人类之间的一致性，并且与来自不同提供者的第二个裁判的一致性保留了模型排名（ρ = 0.88）。数据、生成脚本和评估代码已发布在https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark。

articles.title: What Did the Agent Actually Do? Evidence-Grounded Oversight for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.abstract: As agents take on long-horizon tasks, users shift from making individual decisions to overseeing autonomous execution. Yet the volume of agent activity and the fragmentation of supporting evidence make it difficult to determine which decisions warrant user verification. We study monitors that identify consequential decisions and locate evidence to help users assess their implications. We introduce AgentMonBench, a software-engineering benchmark comprising three subsets that cover two complementary dimensions: alignment between requirements and behavior, and awareness of consequential autonomous decisions for verification. To support these judgments, we propose the Evidence-Grounded Behavior Graph (EBG), a training-free method that groups source-linked evidence into behaviors and organizes their relationships into a graph. EBG presents task-oriented views of this graph to help monitors interpret behavior in context. Experiments across eight models show that EBG improves decision identification and evidence localization in most settings compared with direct access to the original context. Further experiments show that EBG's evidence-localization gains persist across input scales and hyperparameter settings, while real-world applications illustrate its practical value for human oversight.
articles.titleCn: 代理实际做了什么？基于证据的长期代理监督
articles.abstractCn: 随着代理承担长期任务，用户从做出独立决策转变为监督自主执行。然而，代理活动的数量以及支持证据的碎片化使得确定哪些决策需要用户验证变得困难。我们研究了能够识别重要决策并定位证据以帮助用户评估其影响的监控器。我们引入了AgentMonBench，这是一个软件工程基准，包含三个子集，涵盖两个互补维度：需求与行为之间的对齐，以及对需要验证的重要自主决策的意识。为了支持这些判断，我们提出了基于证据的行为图（EBG），这是一种无需训练的方法，将源链接证据分组为行为，并将它们之间的关系组织成图。EBG向监控器呈现面向任务的观点，以帮助其在上下文中解释行为。在八个模型上的实验表明，与直接访问原始上下文相比，EBG在大多数情况下提高了决策识别和证据定位。进一步的实验表明，EBG的证据定位收益在输入规模和超参数设置变化时依然保持，而实际应用则展示了其在人工监督中的实用价值。

articles.title: RAISED: Self-Distillation for Robustness to Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because they must act on untrusted external content. Existing training-time defenses can reduce attack success rates, but often at the cost of general capabilities. We show that training-based defenses induce substantial drift in the model's output distribution, altering its behavior even in benign settings and providing a potential mechanism for utility degradation. We further identify a failure mode of these defenses: On benign tool-use tasks, the model refrains from a step needed to finish an authorized task, particularly when that step is indicated by a tool output. To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through Self-Distillation), a training framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation. The model first generates its own tool-use scenarios, with an emphasis on cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. Then, through self-distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher's clean-context behavior on both clean and injected variants of the same trajectory. RAISED substantially reduces the attack success rate of prompt injections in tool responses while, unlike prior training-based defenses, preserving utility on both agentic and general-purpose benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 提出：用于提升大语言模型代理对提示注入攻击鲁棒性的自蒸馏方法
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具的语言模型代理容易受到间接提示注入攻击，因为它们必须处理不可信的外部内容。现有的训练时防御措施可以降低攻击成功率，但通常以牺牲通用能力为代价。我们证明，基于训练的防御会导致模型输出分布出现显著漂移，即使在良性设置中也改变其行为，并提供了一种潜在的效用退化机制。我们进一步识别了这些防御措施的一种失效模式：在良性工具使用任务中，模型会避免执行完成授权任务所需的步骤，尤其是在该步骤由工具输出指示时。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了RAISED（通过自蒸馏实现鲁棒的攻击不变性），这是一个结合自生成和自蒸馏的训练框架。模型首先生成自己的工具使用场景，特别强调那些任务完成需要根据工具输出中的合法指导来执行的情况。然后，通过自蒸馏，学生模型被训练以在相同轨迹的干净和注入变体上匹配教师模型的干净上下文行为。RAISED显著降低了工具响应中提示注入攻击的成功率，同时与先前的基于训练的防御措施不同，它既在代理基准测试中，也在通用基准测试中保留了效用。

articles.title: Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering
articles.abstract: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.
articles.titleCn: 通过影响力进行转向：用于激活转向的曲率感知数据加权
