articles.abstractCn: 推理时引导通过估计概念在激活空间中的表征并将激活向其偏移，为语言模型的输出提供低成本、细粒度的控制。现有方法从对比数据集的激活平均值构建这些表征。这些平均值包含了不相关的概念和噪声，并且被少数几个词主导，这意味着激活传输编码的是词级而非主题级概念。在这项工作中，我们引导模型朝向最能主题表达概念而非所有概念的示例。我们使用影响函数来识别这些示例，影响函数估计每个数据点对模型概念表征的贡献程度。与简单的模型激活相似度不同，它们考虑了模型损失曲面的曲率，从而能够捕捉超越表面词级相似度的概念相关关系。然后，我们提出了影响加权激活传输，该传输使用最优传输将非概念文本的激活引导向概念文本的激活，并根据影响分数对概念示例进行加权。我们在毒性抑制（Jigsaw）、基于对象的 концепт 启发（OneSec）和真实性启发（TruthfulQA）上进行了评估，优于现有的激活传输基线。我们使用困惑度和MMLU准确度追踪引导后的能力，发现我们的方法在提高引导效果的同时，基本保留了模型质量。我们进一步表明，影响函数捕捉了激活方法所遗漏的概念相关信息，这两种方法对数据点的排序差异显著。这些结果共同证明了考虑曲率的影响信息对于激活引导的价值。

articles.title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.
articles.titleCn: 基于本体概念的训练信号：知识引导的强化学习在临床问答中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的强化学习后训练依赖于两种奖励设计：人类偏好（RLHF、DPO）和二元验证器（RLVR）。临床问题回答不符合这两种设计。近乎正确的答案仅因单个替换实体而不同，且没有可执行的检查来决定临床正确性。我们从维护的受控词汇表中实例化了一个软验证器：通过scispaCy的UMLS概念唯一标识符重叠（基于集合级别的F1）提供一个分级的外部指定奖励，该奖励在模型不参与的情况下计算。我们将它与GRPO中的熵归一化LLM裁判相结合，后者涵盖了重叠无法看到的 安全性和证据轴，并对填充和重复施加小的连贯性惩罚，以保持早期训练样本可评分。这个三项复合体在Phi-3-mini（3.8B）上对MedQA的EM指标提高了2.9%（0.700 vs 0.680），Token-F1提高了39%（0.202 vs 0.145）；在Llama-3.2-3B上相应的提升分别是EM指标14%和Token-F1指标35%。我们报告Token-F1作为主要指标，因为它承认部分正确的临床内容，而EM在这个开放生成规模下会丢弃这些内容。主表结果是在3个种子上的平均值，标准差低于0.005。该方法迁移到PubMedQA，使用相同的复合奖励在PubMedQA训练集上训练，Phi-3-mini的Token-F1比SFT提高了22%，Llama-3.2-3B提高了17%，而无需重新调优。对Phi-3的奖励消融实验，在固定连贯性权重下变化裁判-本体分裂，将3个EM点归因于本体术语，这一贡献捕获了裁判无法识别的实体替换。三个负面发现限制了设计：在随机负样本下DPO对强先验模型的表现不如SFT，但对最弱先验模型有帮助；在稀疏神经奖励下PPO发散；KL-in-loss的GRPO在7B时崩溃。

articles.title: Breaking Bureaucracy: Evaluating open-source LLMs for legal document review
articles.abstract: In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data. We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains. Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain. Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms.
articles.titleCn: 打破官僚体制：评估开源大型语言模型在法律文件审查中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们评估了开源生成式大型语言模型在法律自然语言推理（NLI）任务上的表现。法律监管流程通常发生在特定领域，并经常涉及机密数据。这催生了对本地模型的需求，这些模型无需标记训练数据即可工作。我们在ContractNLI基准测试和两个NLI4Wills数据集上评估了我们的模型。我们成功复制了该任务的基础模型（Span NLI BERT），并评估了多个开源大型语言模型在相同任务上的表现。我们分析了模型的无效率及其在不同温度设置和领域下的稳定性。在生成式模型中，Gemma-4 26B表现最佳，准确率达到81.2%，甚至在某个指标上超过了监督模型。在准确率方面，使用零样本方法无法超越监督模型。Qwen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI以及法律遗嘱领域的其他数据集上表现良好。我们的研究表明，在缺乏监督数据的情况下，零样本、开源的生成式大型语言模型是现实世界法律NLI任务的一种可行替代方案。我们的代码可在https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms获取。

articles.title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
articles.abstract: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, submitted for review to Nature Communications Materials
articles.titleCn: 基于代理模式的科学文献材料工艺知识提取
articles.abstractCn: 材料文献包含详细的实验知识，但程序、化学实体和测量数据仍然难以聚合，因为它们以异构形式报告，并依赖于特定工艺的上下文。我们提出了SciKGExtract，这是一个基于模式的框架，它结合了大型语言模型的提取、化学标准化以及基于代理的评估和细化，然后再进行知识图谱集成。我们在176篇关于氧化锌（ZnO）和铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）的原子层沉积论文上评估了该框架，以及一个专家标注的完整模式子集。PubChem标准化提高了每个测试模型的精确匹配提取F1分数。对于ZnO，最佳F1分数从直接标准化提取的0.591提高到使用代理细化后的0.805，而IGZO的最佳结果为0.344，揭示了多组分超循环工艺的更大难度。针对包含65个实验属性和155个定量测量节点的深度嵌套模式进行评估，进一步暴露了工艺分段和数值分配中的错误。这些结果表明，化学规范化和目标代理验证为将复杂的材料文献转化为可重用、可由机器操作的实验知识提供了互补的控制。

articles.title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
articles.abstract: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.
articles.titleCn: DialectSentEval 2026：阿拉伯方言情感分析及替换共享任务
articles.abstractCn: 情感分析是自然语言处理（NLP）中的一个基本问题。由于阿拉伯语方言数量庞大，标准的阿拉伯语情感分类仍然具有挑战性。为了推进该领域的研究，本文提出了阿拉伯语方言情感分析与转换共享任务（DialectSentEval），由阿拉伯语自然语言处理会议（ArabicNLP 2026）主办。该共享任务包含两个子任务：子任务1侧重于多类别和多方言情感分析，要求模型识别不同阿拉伯方言中的情感极性。子任务2引入了阿拉伯语情感转换的生成任务，挑战模型在保持核心语义的同时反转情感极性。在本文的概述中，我们介绍了研究动机、数据集创建，并总结了参与模型的主要研究成果。

articles.title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
articles.abstract: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.
articles.titleCn: 面向生成式AI工作负载的智能内容摄取
articles.abstractCn: 机器学习的发展不断改变着人工智能系统中智能的所在位置。在传统机器学习中，任务、数据表示、标签和模型架构紧密耦合，因此数据准备过程狭窄、受模式约束且可见。生成式人工智能将模型与任何单一任务解耦：一个基础模型服务于开放式的下游任务，模型端获得的一般性在数据端得到异构性的匹配，因为企业知识以人们使用的格式（PDF、演示文稿、电子表格、扫描文档、表单、表格、图表和混合布局文件）呈现，这些格式同时包含文本、视觉、几何和结构信息。语言模型或检索器无法可靠地推理在接口处被错误表示的信息，因此内容提取成为其生命周期中的一个独立阶段，其错误无法被下游的检索器或重新排序器修复。本文提出一个生产就绪的内容提取系统，使这一阶段显式化、可配置和可衡量。该系统集成了选择性OCR路由、以稀缺性优先的策展引擎，该引擎具有基于参考提取评分器，可衡量字符、单词和表格结构准确性，一个确定性结构感知的父子分段器，以及一个只读检索评估器，该评估器从每一页生成基于事实的问题，并报告Hit@k、平均倒数排名和延迟。在一个180份文档语料库上，最佳提取器得分100分中的97.4分（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995），分段器在25,050个生成问题上达到Hit@1的68.6%、Hit@10的92.8%和MRR 0.77。我们提炼出三条设计原则（结构优先于语义、永不修改你所衡量的内容、预算你的标签），并将可衡量的内容提取定位为企业智能系统中的感知层。

articles.title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
articles.abstract: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.
articles.titleCn: 从辱骂性语言分类到序列标注识别
articles.abstractCn: 工业内容审核必须在严格的延迟限制下处理海量消息流，然而大多数滥用语言（AL）检测系统依赖句子级分类（ALC），这种系统既无法定位滥用语言片段，也无法识别目标对象。我们将滥用语言识别（ALI）定义为一种序列标注任务，该任务联合提取滥用语言片段和目标提及，并评估这种方法是否适用于文本审核。在一个从生产审核流程中抽取的试点语料库上，我们比较了ALI与ALC在跨领域泛化和隐式滥用方面的表现，并评估了滥用语言和目标片段的检测效果。ALI在提供定位输出给审核员的同时，与ALC保持竞争力，并在隐式滥用方面展现出适度且配置敏感的优势。精确的滥用语言边界和目标片段仍然难以恢复。我们通过定性分析补充了这一比较，并讨论了完整目标片段链接和ALI结构化基准的视角。

articles.title: DeferKV: Rethinking Eviction Timing for One-Shot KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but the growing KV cache introduces substantial memory and inference overhead. Existing one-shot KV cache compression methods typically commit to irreversible eviction immediately after prefill, before any signal from actual generation becomes available. Our quantitative analysis shows that early queries from the actual generation stage provide attention signals that are more consistent with subsequent decode attention, with the largest single-step gain occurring at the prefill-decode boundary. Based on this observation, we propose DeferKV, which moves the eviction decision from the end of prefill to the first real decoding step and temporally combines prompt-side and decode-side observations, thereby better aligning KV importance estimation with subsequent generation requirements. DeferKV requires no additional training, draft model, or future-query prediction module, making it simple and easy to deploy. Experiments on LongBench, RULER, and Needle-in-a-Haystack demonstrate that DeferKV consistently improves model performance under KV cache compression while maintaining low inference latency.
articles.titleCn: DeferKV：重新思考单次键值缓存压缩的驱逐时机
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛任务中展现出强大能力，但不断增长的KV缓存带来了显著的内存和推理开销。现有的单次KV缓存压缩方法通常在预填充后立即做出不可逆的驱逐决定，而在此前并未获得实际生成阶段的任何信号。我们的定量分析表明，实际生成阶段早期的查询提供了与后续解码注意力更一致的注意力信号，最大单步增益发生在预填充-解码边界。基于这一观察，我们提出了DeferKV，该方案将驱逐决定从预填充结束移至首个真实解码步骤，并时间上结合提示侧和解码侧的观察，从而更好地使KV重要性估计与后续生成需求相匹配。DeferKV无需额外训练、草稿模型或未来查询预测模块，使其简单易部署。在LongBench、RULER和Needle-in-a-Haystack上的实验表明，DeferKV在KV缓存压缩的同时始终提升模型性能，并保持低推理延迟。

articles.title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
articles.abstract: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name-race data. Thus, $\ell$BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name-race data are unavailable.
articles.titleCn: 基于群体特定姓名列表的概率种族和民族预测
articles.abstractCn: 对种族和民族差异进行统计有效估计通常需要推断个体仅根据其姓名和地理位置属于特定种族或民族群体的概率。标准方法贝叶斯改进姓氏地理编码（BISG）依赖于每个姓名的群体人口频率。尽管美国人口普查局为常见姓名和有限的一组种族类别提供了此类信息，但许多种族和民族群体缺乏可比数据，且此类数据在美国以外地区很少可用。我们提出了基于列表的BISG（$\ell$BISG）方法，该方法可用于从特定群体姓名列表中推导校准的群体概率。这些列表可以基于专家知识编制，或使用大型语言模型（LLM）合成生成，因此可能存在未知偏差。我们将姓名表示为嵌入，将列表成员视为代理预测任务，并应用基于邻近推理的校正来恢复目标群体概率。我们在具有自我报告种族的美国选民文件、完整的1900年美国人口普查和黎巴嫩选民登记册上验证了该方法。我们发现，LLM生成的姓名列表能够产生准确且校准良好的概率，以及与需要姓名-种族数据的方法获得的差异估计相当精确的结果。因此，$\ell$BISG极大地扩展了概率种族和民族预测在姓名-种族数据不可用环境中的应用范围。

articles.title: Shared Stopping Decisions Change Answers in HQQ Cache Quantization
articles.abstract: Language-model systems batch questions for throughput, but unrelated questions should not change a target's answer when its input and numerical execution are fixed. We study compression of the key and value cache, which stores attention representations reused during generation. With request-local groups, Transformers' Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) backend updates compression parameters separately but uses a shared average error to decide when all updates stop. Replacing only the question batched with the target changes four-bit HQQ answers in 170/384 test comparisons across two models. Replaying the other execution's update counts reproduces its complete answer and cache fingerprints in every changed pair, in both directions. Computing the stopping mean in FP32 reduces cache differences but leaves answer changes. Native HQQ also changes confirmed numerical correctness in eight arithmetic pairs. Fixed iterations and request-local stopping remove observed companion dependence under matched controls. Request-local stopping remains sensitive to synthetic padding changes at the tensor level. Fixing the original iteration budget removes this decision path without tuning. Neither repair has an established quality advantage, and natural rebatching still changes answers. Request-independence audits must cover stopping decisions as well as quantization groups.
articles.titleCn: 共享停止决策会改变HQQ缓存量化的答案
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型系统为了提高吞吐量会批量处理问题，但无关问题时，只要输入和数值执行固定，不应改变目标答案。我们研究了键和值缓存的压缩，这些缓存存储了生成过程中重复使用的注意力表示。通过请求局部组，Transformer的半二次量化（HQQ）后端会分别更新压缩参数，但使用共享的平均误差来决定何时停止所有更新。仅替换被目标批量处理的问题，在两个模型的170/384测试比较中改变了四比特HQQ答案。重放其他执行的更新计数，在每对更改中，可以重现其完整答案和缓存指纹，双向均如此。在FP32中计算停止均值减少了缓存差异，但留下了答案变化。原生HQQ也改变了八个算术对中确认的数值正确性。固定迭代次数和请求局部停止消除了在匹配控制下观察到的伴随依赖性。请求局部停止仍然对张量级别的合成填充变化敏感。固定原始迭代预算可以移除这一决策路径，而无需调整。两种修复方法都没有已建立的质量优势，自然重批处理仍然会改变答案。请求独立性审计必须涵盖停止决策以及量化组。

articles.title: DP-ES: Differentially Private Evolution Strategies for Prompt Optimization
articles.abstract: Token-level differentially private (DP) prompt optimization methods such as DP-OPT can become unstable under tight privacy budgets: on GSM8K, DP-OPT obtains $49.5\pm28.5\%$ across 30 runs, and a logged search trajectory reveals prompt-template drift and noise-sensitive irreversible choices. We diagnose these as structural consequences of greedy token-by-token construction over privately aggregated counts. We then propose DP-ES (Differentially Private Evolution Strategies), a structurally cleaner alternative that maintains a population of full prompts, mutates them via LLM calls that never access the private dataset, and spends privacy only on sampled-Gaussian evaluation; deterministic or Gumbel-smoothed selection is post-processing. Under a conservative $(\varepsilon\leq1.0,δ=10^{-5})$ guarantee, DP-ES achieves 88.1% on GSM8K (+38.6 pp over DP-OPT, approximately 9 times lower standard deviation), 99.7% on MedQA, 73.5% on BANKING77, and 86.8% on Alpaca. It is also 2.5 times faster in wall-clock time and uses 3.3 times fewer logged private-data call groups than DP-OPT. Selection and population ablations, implementation-level noise checks, and a 200-profile exact-match memorization stress test complement the formal guarantee. Scope: Our experiments establish optimization robustness under DP noise, especially where prompt structure is critical; end-to-end validation on genuinely sensitive, non-saturated deployment data remains future work.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/StephCpa/dp-es
articles.titleCn: DP-ES：用于提示优化的差分隐私进化策略
articles.abstractCn: 基于token级别的差分隐私（DP）提示优化方法，如DP-OPT，在严格的隐私预算下可能变得不稳定：在GSM8K上，DP-OPT在30次运行中获得了49.5±28.5%的结果，并且记录的搜索轨迹揭示了提示模板漂移和对噪声敏感的不可逆选择。我们将这些问题诊断为由在私有聚合计数上贪婪地逐token构建的结构性后果。然后，我们提出了DP-ES（差分隐私进化策略），这是一种结构更简洁的替代方案，它维护一组完整的提示，通过从未访问私有数据集的LLM调用对其进行变异，并在采样高斯评估上花费隐私；确定性或Gumbel平滑选择是后处理。在保守的保证（ε≤1.0,δ=10^-5）下，DP-ES在GSM8K上达到88.1%（比DP-OPT高38.6个百分点，标准差大约低9倍），在MedQA上达到99.7%，在BANKING77上达到73.5%，在Alpaca上达到86.8%。它还比DP-OPT在墙上时间上快2.5倍，并使用了3.3倍更少的记录私有数据调用组。选择和种群消融实验、实现级别的噪声检查以及200个配置文件的精确匹配记忆压力测试补充了形式保证。范围：我们的实验在DP噪声下建立了优化鲁棒性，特别是在提示结构至关重要的情况下；端到端验证在真正敏感的非饱和部署数据上仍然是未来的工作。

articles.title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
articles.abstract: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.
articles.titleCn: 多语言LLM路由的预生成成功探针的跨语言校准
articles.abstractCn: 预生成成功探针通过解码前语言模型的隐藏激活来估计响应正确性，从而实现成本感知路由。虽然先前研究主要在英语输入上证明了其效用，但我们从三个维度研究了它们在不同语言中的可靠性：（1）是否能保持可能成功和失败的排序（区分性）；（2）是否能保留与观察到的成功频率相匹配的概率（校准性）；以及（3）在不同候选模型中是否能产生足够可比的分数，以实现成本感知的多语言路由（实用性）。我们使用10种语言的3000个数学问题和8种开放权重模型配置，比较了英语训练探针和等预算多语言池化探针的跨语言迁移。英语训练探针保留了有用的跨语言区分性，但在迁移后校准性变差。池化多语言监督改进了这两种特性，并产生了更可靠的成功估计。在路由实验中，池化路由器在相对于始终选择平均成功率最高的模型的情况下，将测试成功率提高了0.7%，同时将建模成本降低了13.0%。这些结果表明，多语言路由需要保持良好校准且在不同语言和模型中具有可比性的成功估计。

articles.title: Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers
articles.abstract: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents), Paris
articles.titleCn: 小型语言模型是否学会谈判？一项关于强化学习训练卖家的受控规模研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理正开始掌控完整的客户体验。不久，LLM可能将分别代表公司和客户进行买卖。小型模型在规模上更具成本效益，但强化学习能否将它们训练成称职的卖家？我们使用GRPO在双边多议题议价中的程序化效用奖励，训练了四个Gemma 4检查点（有效参数量从2.3B到31B），并在相同的1,152场谈判中，对每个检查点与从未在训练中见过的两个前沿买家进行评估。对于所有规模，我们使用相同的学习率（$10^{-6}$），RL模型的增益相对于其基础模型从2.3B时的+0.001提升到31B时的+0.078。每个规模只训练一次，且两个最小的检查点使用不同的架构，因此我们没有拟合任何缩放规律。将学习率提高三倍，使用相同或更少的训练步数，在所有规模上相对于共享率的提升从+0.032（2.3B）到+0.081（4.5B）。在与作为卖家的两个前沿模型进行的探索性比较中，12B的卖家在提高三倍的学习率下得分超过两者，尽管其未训练的基础模型已经达到了相同的得分。在相同学习率下，4.5B的卖家与两者之间没有可检测到的差异，且能在一个48 GB GPU上运行。进一步增加2.3B的检查点，使用十倍于共享率的学习率，虽然提升了总得分，但其增益集中在与训练池共享模型系列的评估买家上。这些结果表明，在断定小型模型无法学习谈判之前，应先调整学习率，并测试来自多个模型系列的买家。

articles.title: Judged Useless, Queried Anyway: Tool-Using Agents Rarely Turn Their Own Evidence Judgments into Stopping Decisions
articles.abstract: An agent whose tool keeps returning nothing useful should stop relying on it. In a retrieval environment with controlled source failures, we separate how agents judge results from what they do. We compare stopping at the same step after longer and shorter runs of results the agent judged useless; this contrast is zero for clock- or deadline-driven stopping. Where we record their judgments, the seven agents we test call a failing source's results useless 97-100% of the time, yet most of them rarely stop on that judgment. Prompt cues change when they stop but not what they stop on. Permission to answer from memory and a reasoning mode can bring early stops regardless of evidence, a stated budget moves the 7-8B models' stops to the deadline, and a stopping rule or call cost in the prompt is followed at most partly. Stopping follows the evidence only when the harness enforces an integration step that makes the agent answer after five consecutive results it judged useless. This step raises failing-source success for every model, keeps the stopping point fixed when the budget doubles, and needs no extra judgment call when the agent states its judgments. A pre-registered replication on 300 fresh questions confirms the dissociation and the rule's effect.
articles.titleCn: 被判定无用，仍予查询：使用工具的智能体很少将自身证据判断转化为停止决策
articles.abstractCn: 一个工具持续返回无用结果的代理应当停止依赖它。在一个具有可控源故障的检索环境中，我们将代理如何判断结果与其行为分离开来。我们比较了代理在判断结果无用后，在较长和较短运行结果序列中停止的情况；这种对比在时钟或截止时间驱动的停止情况下为零。在我们记录其判断的情况下，我们测试的七个代理在97-100%的时间内将失败源的结果判断为无用，但其中大多数很少基于这种判断而停止。当它们停止时，提示线索会改变，但它们停止的对象不会改变。允许从记忆中回答的权限和推理模式可以无视证据而提前停止，声明的预算将7-8B模型的停止时间移至截止时间，提示中的停止规则或调用成本最多只部分遵循。只有当套件强制执行一个集成步骤，使代理在连续判断为无用的五个结果后回答时，停止才会遵循证据。这个步骤提高了每个模型对失败源的成功率，在预算翻倍时保持停止点不变，并且当代理陈述其判断时无需额外的判断调用。对300个新问题的预先注册复制证实了分离现象和规则的效果。

articles.title: What Does It Cost to Simulate a Quantum Sentence Classifier? An Energy and Compute Perspective on Near-Term QNLP
articles.abstract: Near-term quantum natural language processing (QNLP) experiments often run on classical simulators, so simulator cost is part of the field's practical compute burden, yet accuracy tables do not show it. We measure that cost for a variational quantum classifier (VQC) on binary SST-2 sentiment classification, using PennyLane's state-vector simulator over a controlled grid of 27 configurations: three balanced training-set sizes (N = 200, 500, 1000), three qubit counts (4, 6, 8), and three circuit depths. Each VQC is compared with logistic regression on the same PCA-reduced input; full TF-IDF logistic regression gives an uncompressed reference. The VQC beats its matched baseline in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons. After reruns at two further seeds, only 1 of these 6 keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its paired seed-to-seed variability, and paired tests on the fixed validation set do not establish it. VQC training is 886-21,127 times slower in measured wall-clock time than the matched classical fit (median 3,158 times); going from 4 to 8 qubits roughly doubles simulator time, and within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. CodeCarbon energy and CO2 estimates are secondary: they imply an almost constant power of about 41 W, so they add little beyond runtime, and we do not build an energy ratio from them. The study is narrow (one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment) and is a reproducible feasibility measurement, not a general verdict on QNLP.
articles.titleCn: 模拟一个量子句子分类器需要多少成本？从近期能量和计算的角度看量子自然语言处理
articles.abstractCn: 近期量子自然语言处理（QNLP）实验通常在经典模拟器上运行，因此模拟器成本是该领域实际计算负担的一部分，但准确度表格并未体现这一点。我们使用PennyLane的状态向量模拟器，在27种配置的控制网格上测量了变分量子分类器（VQC）在二元SST-2情感分类任务中的成本：三种平衡的训练集大小（N = 200, 500, 1000）、三种量子比特数量（4, 6, 8）以及三种电路深度。每个VQC都与同一PCA降维输入上的逻辑回归进行比较；完整的TF-IDF逻辑回归提供了未压缩的参考基准。在27次单种子比较中，VQC在其中的6次超过了匹配的基线。在两个进一步种子的重跑后，这6次中只有1次保持了大于其配对种子间变异性正的平均优势，且在固定验证集上的配对测试并未证实这一点。VQC训练在测量的墙上时间比匹配的经典拟合慢886-21,127倍（中位数3,158倍）；从4个量子比特增加到8个量子比特大致将模拟器时间翻倍，在测试范围内每步成本很好地近似为参数数量的线性函数。CodeCarbon的能源和CO2估算次要：它们暗示约41 W的近似恒定功率，因此除了运行时间外几乎不增加额外成本，我们未从这些估算中构建能源比率。该研究范围较窄（一个数据集、表示、ansatz、模拟器和CPU环境），是一项可复现的可行性测量，而非对QNLP的普遍评判。

articles.title: Anosognosia in LLMs: Probing Self-Awareness of Quantized Computational Substrate
articles.abstract: Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate? Inspired by anosognosia, a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization. We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue. Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints. Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output. A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels. Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations. Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.
articles.titleCn: LLMs中的无意识认知：探测量化计算基底的自我意识
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能否识别其自身计算基底的退化？受无意识失认症（一种患者无法识别自身能力缺陷的神经系统疾病）的启发，我们研究了大型语言模型能否识别量化所引起的计算基底的退化。我们首先证明，即使提供模型自身生成的文本作为外部线索，现有模型也无法自我报告其量化状态。线性探测揭示，虽然生成的文本几乎不含量化的痕迹，但内部表示却包含清晰、特定于方法的指纹。通过训练，模型能够通过比较识别严重退化的输出（如4位模型的输出），但仍然无法从单个输出中识别。跨量化级别共同训练的共享LoRA成功读取了内部指纹，但在未见过的量化方法上失败，仅仅将特定于方法的指纹映射到标签。虽然外部自我观察在某些人类无意识失认症病例中可以恢复意识，但我们的结果表明，在大型语言模型中实现这种意识更有希望的途径可能在于其内部表示。我们的结果突显了大型语言模型自我监控泛化能力的基本局限性。

articles.title: MS-Exam-Gen: Source-Grounded Benchmark Construction for Evaluating LLMs on Textual Multiple Sclerosis MRI Knowledge
articles.abstract: Biomedical large language model (LLM) evaluation requires auditable assessment of narrow, evolving, source-grounded subspecialty knowledge. Multiple sclerosis MRI (MS-MRI) provides a high-stakes textual-knowledge test case because correct reasoning requires current diagnostic criteria, standardized acquisition and reporting knowledge, longitudinal monitoring concepts, lesion morphology, and recognition of difficult mimics. We present MS-Exam-Gen, a reproducible framework for constructing and auditing a text-based multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmark for MS-MRI knowledge; it does not evaluate direct MRI image interpretation. MS-Exam-Gen targets source-grounded criteria, protocols, reporting, and differential diagnosis. The framework combines expert-source indexing, exam-oriented topic induction, evidence-grounded MCQ generation, automated quality audits, a same-family consistency screen, and empirical calibration. From a 66-source corpus indexed into 4,289 retrieval chunks, the pipeline produced a locked 3,058-item candidate benchmark spanning 16 topics and 53 subtopics. Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%). Across these endpoints, 25.5% of items were missed by at least four. Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive. Generated construction labels remain metadata rather than validated psychometric categories. Because expert adjudication and full option-order counterbalancing remain future work, MS-Exam-Gen is not a clinically certified examination. It should be interpreted as an automatically filtered, source-grounded candidate benchmark and reproducible audit workflow for item-level and topic-specific LLM evaluation.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication to BHI 2026
articles.titleCn: MS-Exam-Gen：用于评估文本多发性硬化症MRI知识的LLM的源导向基准构建
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学大型语言模型（LLM）评估需要可审计的评估狭窄、发展、基于源知识的亚专业领域知识。多发性硬化症磁共振成像（MS-MRI）提供了一个高风险的文本知识测试案例，因为正确的推理需要当前的诊断标准、标准化的采集和报告知识、纵向监测概念、病灶形态以及识别困难的类症。我们提出了MS-Exam-Gen，一个可重复的框架，用于构建和审计基于文本的多项选择题（MCQ）基准，用于MS-MRI知识；它不评估直接的MRI图像解释。MS-Exam-Gen针对基于源标准的诊断标准、协议、报告和鉴别诊断。该框架结合了专家源索引、面向考试的课题归纳、基于证据的MCQ生成、自动化质量审计、同家族一致性筛选和经验校准。从66个源语料库索引的4,289个检索块中，该流程生成了一个包含3,058个项目的锁定候选基准，涵盖16个主题和53个子主题。在12个主要LLM端点的评估中产生了36,696个项目级预测，并分离了42.8个百分点的准确率范围（89.7%至46.9%）。在这些端点中，25.5%的项目至少被四个人错过。生成后的审计显示，刷新的构建减少了可测量的答案线索，而选项顺序测试显示绝对MCQ分数仍然对位置敏感。生成的构建标签仍然是元数据，而不是经过验证的心理测量类别。由于专家裁决和完整的选项顺序平衡仍然是未来的工作，MS-Exam-Gen不是临床认证的考试。它应该被解释为自动过滤的、基于源的候选基准和可重复的审计工作流程，用于项目级和主题特定的LLM评估。

articles.title: Introducing Code-Switched Contexts to Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Model Training
articles.abstract: During language acquisition, bilingual children are regularly exposed to code-switched input and use it as a cognitive scaffold to accelerate vocabulary growth and cross-linguistic syntactic mapping. In contrast, computational bilingual models are conventionally pretrained on interleaved monolingual corpora. While introducing synthetic code-switching during pretraining has become a promising strategy to enhance cross-lingual alignment and downstream performance, the structural and developmental parameters governing the success remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of training with synthetic code-switched data across two typologically distinct language pairs by controlling two key variables: the structural location of code-switches and the dynamic switching rate across training stages. Our results show that training with code-switched data improves cross-lingual alignment for typologically close languages.
articles.titleCn: 将代码转换环境引入基于认知的双语模型训练
articles.abstractCn: 在语言习得过程中，双语儿童会经常接触到代码转换输入，并将其作为认知支架来加速词汇增长和跨语言句法映射。相比之下，计算双语模型通常在交替的单语语料库上进行预训练。虽然引入合成代码转换作为预训练过程中的策略已成为增强跨语言对齐和下游性能的可行方法，但控制其成功的关键结构和发育参数仍然知之甚少。在本工作中，我们通过控制两个关键变量——代码转换的结构位置和训练阶段中的动态转换率——来研究使用合成代码转换数据进行训练在两种类型学上不同的语言对中的效率。我们的结果表明，使用代码转换数据进行训练可以提高类型学上相近语言的跨语言对齐效果。

articles.title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
articles.titleCn: 基于候选验证和发散偏移的高效测试时自适应
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）具有强大的零样本迁移能力，但在推理时对目标域的偏移仍然很脆弱。测试时适应（TTA）提供了一种实用的解决方案，然而大多数现有的VLM-TTA方法遵循预测端适应范式。它们使用测试样本来调整logits、原型、缓存、先验或特征统计，通常会产生额外的计算开销。在本文中，我们从一个不同的角度出发，将VLM-TTA重新定义为候选验证而非预测调整。我们提出了测试时校正（TTC），这是一个基于假设的校正框架，由一个简单的原则指导：假设、重建、校正。给定一个测试特征及其前k个候选标签，TTC将每个候选标签视为一个假设，在存储在内存库中的相应潜在子空间内重建该特征，并测量由此产生的发散偏移。这种偏移量化了在假设插入测试特征后候选子空间及其与其他候选关系的变化程度。正确的候选假设只会引起较小的偏移，而错误的假设则会更强烈地扰动子空间。因此，TTC通过选择具有最小累积发散偏移的候选来校正预测。这种无需训练的候选验证机制避免了迭代优化，并提供了有利的精度-效率权衡。在五个TTA设置和15个基准数据集上，包括零样本分类、域泛化、少样本分类、基础到新泛化以及跨数据集评估，TTC始终比最先进的VLM-TTA方法提高了准确率，同时实现了高达2倍的加速，CPU内存使用降低超过3倍，GPU内存使用降低高达1.4倍，优于最低内存的无需训练基线。

articles.title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
articles.abstract: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.
articles.titleCn: 从痕迹到能动世界：用于交互式环境模拟的能动语言世界模型
articles.abstractCn: 逼真的环境复制品对于训练和评估大型语言模型代理日益重要，但原始系统可能难以获取或复现。我们探索了代理式语言世界建模：与其重新构建可执行环境，世界模型代理作为任务代理的环境，并支持忠实且状态化的模拟。我们通过Trace2Env实例化这一范式，这是一个无学习框架，适用于原始系统不可用但历史交互记录可访问的场景。Trace2Env将这些记录重构为一个可复用的环境世界书，其中包含环境模式、基础证据和诱导的行为知识。在运行时，世界模型代理结合持久化场景状态主动咨询世界书，以推断每个动作的观察结果和持久状态效果。在九个环境中，Trace2Env在基于提示的传统语言世界建模方法上提升了下一观察结果的保真度和长时程交互的一致性。在多轮交互中，任务代理在Trace2Env中生成的动作在真实环境中重放时更常保持有效性，表明其模拟动态能更好地保留早期动作在连续回合中的后果。这些结果确立了代理式语言世界建模为一种替代方向，即在不重建原始可执行系统的情况下构建逼真环境复制品。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII
articles.abstract: The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages. We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language. This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers. Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言迁移性：训练数据提取攻击用于恢复记忆中的个人身份信息
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）中个人身份信息（PII）保护的有效性是一个关键问题，然而跨语言数据提取相关的风险尚未得到充分研究。本研究评估了以英语为中心和多语言模型在非英语提示下遭受训练数据提取（TDE）攻击的脆弱性。我们构建了一个包含社交媒体账号、电子邮件地址和电话号码的多领域PII数据集，并将攻击上下文翻译成意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语。我们的结果表明，针对以英语为中心和多语言模型的TDE攻击可以迁移到不同语言：攻击在翻译后的提示上成功，即使只有原始英语提示可能包含在预训练数据中。对部分翻译的网站存在性检查证实它们在线上不可用。其他语言中恢复的英语泄露比例随着模型的多语言能力增强而增长，当原始措辞丢失时，即使语言未改变，该比例也会急剧下降。这表明，母语多语言预训练促进了潜在跨语言桥梁的出现，从而简化了个人身份信息（PII）的检索。我们分析了多语言大型语言模型（LLMs）的激活状态，发现同一提示的不同翻译在相似表示中相互连接，其中中间层的一致性最强。我们的结果揭示了现代LLMs中的一个基本安全漏洞，需要为未来模型对齐制定更稳健、语言无关的清理策略。

articles.title: Attention Tax, Handoff Tax: A Stylised Model of When Multi-Agent LLM Systems Help
articles.abstract: Recent work on multi-agent LLM systems reaches sharply different conclusions: some results show that a single agent with the same information and compute should dominate a delegated system, others that multi-agent gains grow with task depth. We argue that much of the disagreement comes from modelling different bottlenecks, and introduce a stylised reliability model built around two trade-offs. Decomposition reduces the burden of long contexts but incurs a handoff tax when information is compressed or transferred between agents. Redundancy gains from multiple samples, but its benefit depends on how much their failures are shared. With reasoning budget, verification, and task structure added, the model yields two crossover conditions: decomposition becomes preferable once the attention cost avoided by resetting context exceeds the handoff cost, and parallel sampling at equal budget is eventually preferable when its shared-failure floor lies below the error floor of one agent thinking longer. We connect these regimes to recent theoretical and empirical results. On a ledger-reconciliation task we measure the context-degradation curve and the handoff tax from single-agent and handoff runs alone. From these the model places the crossover at depth 10 and predicts decomposition to win at depths 20, 50, and 100. It does, on step-level and final-balance accuracy, and the decomposed system's success, which the prediction never sees, lands within 9 percentage points of the predicted rate at every depth.
articles.titleCn: 注意力税、切换税：多智能体LLM系统何时提供帮助的模型
articles.abstractCn: 近期关于多智能体大语言模型系统的研究得出了截然不同的结论：部分结果显示，单个智能体在拥有相同信息和计算资源时应主导委托系统，而另一些结果则表明多智能体收益随着任务深度的增加而增长。我们认为，许多分歧源于对不同瓶颈的建模差异，并引入了一个围绕两个权衡的典型可靠性模型。分解可以减轻长上下文带来的负担，但在信息在智能体之间压缩或转移时会产生交接成本。冗余通过多个样本获得收益，但其收益取决于失败如何共享。随着推理预算、验证和任务结构的加入，该模型产生了两个交叉条件：一旦通过重置上下文避免的注意力成本超过交接成本，分解就变得更有优势；当其共享失败底线低于单个智能体长时间思考的错误底线时，同等预算下的并行采样最终更有优势。我们将这些机制与最近的理论和实证结果联系起来。在一个账本对账任务中，我们单独测量了单智能体和交接运行中的上下文退化曲线和交接成本。根据这些数据，该模型将交叉点定在深度10，并预测在深度20、50和100时分解将获胜。它确实在步骤级和最终余额准确率上做到了这一点，并且分解系统的成功——预测从未见过的——在所有深度上都与预测率相差9个百分点以内。

articles.title: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) assistants routinely decide whether they can trust users and third parties whose competence, intentions, and integrity they cannot verify. This uncertainty matters for safety, as trusting the wrong party can lead an agent to comply with harmful requests or act on malicious instructions encountered during tool use. To study this problem, we define trust as an assistant's willingness to accept vulnerability to the actions of another party and ask whether such behavior can be causally controlled through model activations. We build 2,000 contrastive conversations spanning ability, benevolence, and integrity, where paired responses complete the same request but differ in whether the assistant trusts the user. From these pairs, we learn steering matrices while keeping the model parameters frozen and test them across six instruction-tuned models from three families, finding that steering changes trust decisions monotonically in both directions. We then ask whether this effect extends to several safety-related agent settings involving harmful requests, prompt injections, and insider threats, while using benign-task and reasoning as controls. Our findings provide evidence that trust in the user can be causally controlled along linear directions in model activations and provide a way to study how trust shapes safety-relevant behavior in language models.
articles.titleCn: TrustMI：因果控制助手如何信任用户
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手通常会判断是否可以信任那些其能力、意图和诚信无法验证的用户和第三方。这种不确定性对安全性至关重要，因为信任错误的一方可能导致代理遵从有害请求或执行在使用工具过程中遇到的恶意指令。为了研究这一问题，我们将信任定义为助手愿意接受自身对另一方行为脆弱性的程度，并探讨这种行为是否可以通过模型激活进行因果控制。我们构建了2000个对比对话，涵盖能力、善意和诚信三个维度，其中成对的回复完成相同的请求，但助手是否信任用户存在差异。在这些对话对中，我们学习引导矩阵，同时冻结模型参数，并在三个家族的六个指令调优模型上测试这些矩阵，发现引导变化会单调地改变信任决策。随后，我们探讨这种效应是否扩展到涉及有害请求、提示注入和内部威胁等多个与安全相关的代理设置，同时以良性任务和推理作为对照。我们的研究结果表明，用户信任可以通过模型激活中的线性方向进行因果控制，并提供了一种研究信任如何塑造语言模型中与安全相关行为的方法。

articles.title: ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.
articles.titleCn: 旋转隐藏状态朝向上下文向量以减轻LVLMs中的幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）经常出现物体幻觉。现有的无训练干预措施主要通过操纵注意力权重来间接影响到达最终预测层的深层语义。在这项工作中，我们将重点转向自注意力操作和残差加和后提取的隐藏状态向量。实证分析表明，幻觉的标记不仅过度依赖语言先验，反而表现出异常的上下文偏差，在中间层中与文本和视觉上下文的相似度显著降低。受此启发，我们提出了ROT，一种针对特定层、无训练的框架。ROT动态检测中间层的语义偏差，并对隐藏状态应用保范旋转，将其引导回由上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面。对于后续层，引入了表示平滑机制来稳定校准的轨迹。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，ROT在各种模型架构和规模下始终减少幻觉，为基于理解的生成提供了一种高效、几何驱动的解决方案。

articles.title: Backdooring Sparse Autoencoders
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used not only to interpret language models but also to intervene on their internal representations. We show that this creates a supply-chain attack surface: a maliciously modified SAE can induce attacker-chosen behavior when inserted into the forward pass of an otherwise unchanged language model. We introduce a decoder-only SAE backdoor that leaves both the underlying LLM and the SAE encoder frozen, restricting the attack to a single auxiliary component at a single insertion layer. Using code generation as a case study, we demonstrate high rates of unsolicited code insertion across three language models and a wide range of insertion layers, as well as trigger-dependent behavior conditioned on a prompt cue. We further evaluate the modified SAEs using HumanEval and selected SAEBench metrics. While attack effectiveness varies across models and layers, strong backdoor behavior can coexist with relatively small changes in several conventional SAE quality measures. These results establish that SAEs can carry behavioral backdoors without modifying the language model itself and should therefore be treated as security-sensitive components.
articles.titleCn: 后门攻击稀疏自动编码器
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）越来越多地被用于解释语言模型，并干预其内部表示。我们证明，这创造了一个供应链攻击面：恶意修改的SAE在被插入到未修改的语言模型的正向传递中时，可以诱导攻击者选择的行为。我们引入了一种仅解码器的SAE后门，它使底层的大语言模型（LLM）和SAE编码器保持冻结状态，将攻击限制在单个插入层的单个辅助组件上。以代码生成为例，我们展示了在三个语言模型和广泛的插入层中存在高比例的非请自来的代码插入，以及基于提示线索的触发相关行为。我们进一步使用HumanEval和选定的SAEBench指标评估了修改后的SAEs。虽然攻击效果在不同模型和层之间存在差异，但在几种传统的SAE质量指标上相对较小的变化下，强大的后门行为仍然可以共存。这些结果表明，SAEs可以在不修改语言模型本身的情况下携带行为后门，因此应被视为安全敏感组件。

articles.title: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
articles.abstract: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.
articles.titleCn: LightMTP：轻量级潜在多标记预测
articles.abstractCn: 下一词预测（NTP）是大型语言模型的标准化预训练目标，但它仅对紧随其后的词提供明确的训练信号，这可能导致模型利用局部模式，而非捕捉更长距离的结构和概念。多词预测（MTP）通过训练模型预测多个未来词来解决这个问题。然而，现有的MTP方法通常引入大量新参数，而下游性能的提升有限。潜藏MTP方法通过将未来词编码为向量表示来解决效率问题。然而，这些方法通常依赖外部辅助模型进行未来词编码。我们提出了LightMTP，这是一种轻量级（即参数高效）的潜藏MTP方法，它从模型自身的隐藏状态中启动未来词表示。我们的两种LightMTP变体在不增加传统MTP所需的额外计算开销，也不依赖外部潜藏MTP通常依赖的外部监督的情况下，将监督扩展到更多未来词。LightMTP最多增加1%的额外参数，在通用语言建模基准上保持更好的性能，并在规划、编码和推理方面实现了相似的增益。

articles.title: Differentiable Bit-Widths: Co-optimizing Pruning and Quantization via SVD for Ultra-Efficient LLM Compression
articles.abstract: SVD-based pruning and quantization have recently emerged as a promising strategy for the ultra-efficient compression of large language models. In these methods, compression is performed in two stages: components are first truncated, and the remaining ones are subsequently quantized. Although this decoupled pipeline benefits from both pruning and quantization, it requires separate optimization for each stage and fails to fully exploit their balance, which can lead to suboptimal performance under aggressive compression. To address this limitation, we propose a new LLM compression method that co-optimizes pruning and quantization in a unified framework. Our key idea is a differentiable method for learning component-wise bit-widths, allowing less important components to be assigned 0-bit precision and pruned away. Notably, our method performs favorably against two-stage baselines, even when subjected to extreme quantization settings ($1.61$ bits) designed for ultra-efficiency. Code: https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW.
articles.comment: Accepted to Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
articles.titleCn: 可微分的位宽：通过SVD协同优化剪枝和量化，实现超高效LLM压缩
articles.abstractCn: 基于SVD的剪枝和量化最近已成为一种用于超高效压缩大型语言模型的 promising 策略。在这些方法中，压缩分为两个阶段进行：首先截断组件，然后对剩余组件进行量化。尽管这种解耦的流程同时受益于剪枝和量化，但它需要对每个阶段进行单独优化，无法充分利用两者的平衡，这可能导致在激进压缩下性能欠佳。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新的LLM压缩方法，该方法在一个统一的框架中协同优化剪枝和量化。我们的核心思想是一种用于学习逐组件位宽的可微分方法，允许不那么重要的组件被分配0位精度并剪枝去除。值得注意的是，即使在我们为超高效设计的极端量化设置（1.61位）下，我们的方法在对比两阶段基线时表现优异。代码：https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW。

articles.title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
articles.abstract: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.
articles.titleCn: 研究时空视频定位中的查询不敏感行为
articles.abstractCn: 时空视频定位（STVG）旨在将自然语言查询描述的对象或事件定位到时空中的具体位置。现有的STVG模型通常在假设每个查询都与输入视频相关的情况下进行训练和评估。在本工作中，我们通过研究最先进的STVG模型在不相关查询和缺失文本输入下的行为来挑战这一假设。我们的实验表明，即使查询与视频无关或完全移除，当前模型仍然能够生成合理的时空预测。我们进一步分析了HCSTVG-v2和VidSTG，以识别可能导致此类查询不敏感行为的数据库规律性。我们的研究突显了STVG模型的一个尚未充分探索的局限性，并推动了负向感知评估协议和能够明确评估查询相关性的架构。

articles.title: D-Loop: Looped Diffusion Drafting for Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Block diffusion accelerates speculative decoding by drafting multiple tokens in one forward pass. However, each position predicts a marginal distribution without observing earlier proposed tokens, limiting draft quality and acceptance length. We identify a concrete failure, the \emph{repetition trap}, in which neighboring positions produce redundant copies of the same token. We explain this tendency theoretically and empirically examine its association with shorter accepted drafts. Recent methods refine marginal predictions with an additional causal head or a separately trained drafter, increasing parameter storage and introducing separate training objectives. We instead propose D-Loop, which introduces \emph{intra-block causal conditioning} within the original diffusion drafter without additional model components. Inspired by semi-autoregressive generation and parameter sharing, D-Loop reuses the same backbone across looped passes. The first pass proposes a block, and the second conditions on a selected prefix to regenerate the suffix in parallel. A complementary prefix--suffix objective trains the shared drafter for both anchor-only prefix prediction and prefix-conditioned suffix prediction. Across eight math, code, and chat benchmarks, D-Loop can beat DFlash and DSpark on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with obvious gains.
articles.titleCn: D-Loop：用于推测解码的循环扩散草稿
articles.abstractCn: 块扩散通过一次前向传递生成多个标记来加速推测性解码。然而，每个位置在不观察先前提出的标记的情况下预测边缘分布，这限制了生成质量和接受长度。我们识别出一种具体缺陷，即\emph{重复陷阱}，其中相邻位置生成相同标记的冗余副本。我们从理论上解释了这种趋势，并通过实证检验了它与较短接受生成文本的相关性。近期方法通过额外的因果头或单独训练的生成器来改进边缘预测，增加了参数存储并引入了独立的训练目标。我们则提出D-Loop，它在原始扩散生成器内部引入\emph{块内因果条件化}，而无需额外的模型组件。受半自回归生成和参数共享的启发，D-Loop在循环传递中复用相同的骨干网络。第一次传递提出一个块，第二次在选定的前缀上条件再生后缀，并行进行。一个互补的前缀-后缀目标训练共享生成器进行仅锚点前缀预测和前缀条件后缀预测。在八个数学、代码和聊天基准测试中，D-Loop在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上可以超越DFlash和DSpark，并取得明显提升。

articles.title: Turnslide: Scalable Multi-Turn Data Synthesis by Walking a Finite-State Machine
articles.abstract: Small language models are inexpensive to serve and can run on private infrastructure, but base models are often not good enough at multi-turn tool calling, and fine-tuning them needs per-API data that rarely exists. Existing synthesis methods are too expensive for high-scale fine-tuning, as they often require mock operational environments for different domains and multiple LLM calls per generated conversation turn. We introduce a fully automated, lightweight synthesis framework that models each API as a finite-state machine, representing the system as abstract states that determine when each tool may be called, producing state-valid sequences of tools; sequences are translated into complete examples with a single LLM call. Rather than optimize diversity, we set a target distribution over the number of turns, the tool sequence and task complexity. We measure data quality by fine-tuning SLMs on generated trajectories, showing that our FSM-based generation significantly improves downstream accuracy over an unmutated baseline and, against existing works, reaches 70.7% full accuracy over 63.4% and 53.7% with 3.6-6.6$\times$ fewer tokens.
articles.comment: Accepted at the SLM-Agents Workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
articles.titleCn: 转盘式：通过行走有限状态机实现可扩展的多轮数据合成
articles.abstractCn: 小型语言模型部署成本低，可以在私有基础设施上运行，但基础模型在多轮工具调用方面往往不够理想，而微调它们需要特定API的数据，这种数据很少存在。现有的合成方法对于大规模微调来说过于昂贵，因为它们通常需要为不同领域模拟操作环境，并且每个生成的对话轮次需要多次大型语言模型调用。我们引入了一个完全自动化、轻量级的合成框架，将每个API建模为有限状态机，将系统表示为抽象状态，这些状态决定了每个工具何时被调用，从而生成有效的工具序列；序列通过单个大型语言模型调用转换为完整示例。我们不是优化多样性，而是设定了关于回合数、工具序列和任务复杂度的目标分布。我们通过在生成的轨迹上微调小型语言模型来衡量数据质量，表明基于有限状态机的生成方法在未修改的基线之上显著提高了下游准确性，并且与现有工作相比，达到了70.7%的完整准确性，而使用63.4%和53.7%的token数量减少了3.6-6.6倍。

articles.title: Breaking the Tie: A Cluster-Aware Routing Framework for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the emergence of various Large Language Models (LLMs) has created a rich model ecosystem. However, this also brings a key challenge: how to select the optimal model for a specific user query. LLM routing addresses this need by dynamically assigning queries to the most suitable expert in the pool of candidate models. However, existing routing frameworks often simplify this process to a standard classification task; thus, a critical vulnerability is exposed when multiple candidate models correctly answer the same query. We formalize this capability overlap as routing noise, which misleads the router with arbitrarily correct candidate models, ultimately leading to routing collapse (a severe decline in generalization ability on unseen tasks). To address this problem, we propose a novel Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing (CASLR) framework. CASLR shifts the evaluation paradigm from the success of a single query to macro-domain consensus by replacing traditional one-hot vectors with a masked softmax mechanism. Specifically, for experts who answer incorrectly, we penalize their target probability to zero; for the remaining candidates, we directly compute continuous fine-grained soft labels based on their global clustering utility scores. We then use these refined soft labels to supervise a lightweight router. Specifically, the framework not only demonstrates superior accuracy on multiple benchmarks, but also outperforms Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by 7.80% in overall average performance. Furthermore, the extremely low routing inference latency of only 1.13s further confirms that CASLR can achieve efficient system scheduling with almost zero additional overhead, while ensuring high response quality.
articles.titleCn: 打破僵局：一种面向大型语言模型的集群感知路由框架
articles.abstractCn: 随着人工智能的快速发展，各种大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现构建了一个丰富的模型生态系统。然而，这也带来了一个关键挑战：如何为特定用户查询选择最优模型。LLM路由通过将查询动态分配给候选模型池中最合适的专家来应对这一需求。然而，现有的路由框架通常将此过程简化为标准分类任务；因此，当多个候选模型正确回答同一查询时，就会暴露一个关键漏洞。我们将这种能力重叠形式化为路由噪声，它通过任意正确的候选模型误导路由器，最终导致路由崩溃（在未见过任务上的泛化能力严重下降）。为解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的感知聚类的软标签路由（CASLR）框架。CASLR将评估范式从单个查询的成功转移到宏观领域共识，通过用掩码softmax机制替代传统的one-hot向量。具体而言，对于回答错误的专家，我们将其目标概率惩罚为零；对于其余候选模型，我们直接根据其全局聚类效用分数计算连续的细粒度软标签。然后，我们使用这些精细化的软标签来监督一个轻量级路由器。具体来说，该框架不仅在与多个基准测试相比中展现出卓越的准确性，而且在整体平均性能上比Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct高出7.80%。此外，其极低的路由推理延迟仅为1.13秒，进一步证实CASLR能够在几乎零额外开销的情况下实现高效的系统调度，同时确保高响应质量。

articles.title: Byte Language Models: Scaling, Emergent Abstractions, and Information Allocation
articles.abstract: Tokenizer-free language models remove the inductive bias of fixed tokenizers by modeling text directly as bytes, but the resulting longer sequences substantially increase computation and eliminate explicit text abstractions. We ask whether this additional computation can be useful, and whether standard Transformers can learn the abstractions that tokenization provides. We study these questions on Transformers without specialized tokenization-related architectures. With token-superposition training and hash embeddings, byte Transformers consistently outperform subword Transformers as model size scales. We further find that byte Transformers build local text abstractions as external tokenizers: a set of segmentation-like positions are used to collect local context representations, and restricting up to $25\%$ of intermediate layers to these local representations preserves downstream performance. Finally, these learned structures induce highly non-uniform generation difficulty, with uncertainty concentrated near local structure boundaries; exploiting them for speculative decoding yields $3.4\times$ more accepted tokens than in subword Transformers.
articles.titleCn: 字节语言模型：规模扩展、涌现抽象与信息分配
articles.abstractCn: 无分词器语言模型通过直接将文本建模为字节来消除固定分词器的归纳偏差，但由此产生的更长的序列会显著增加计算量并消除显式的文本抽象。我们探究这种额外的计算是否具有效用，以及标准Transformer能否学习分词器提供的抽象。我们在没有专门分词器相关架构的Transformer上研究这些问题。通过分词叠加训练和哈希嵌入，随着模型规模的扩大，字节Transformer始终优于子词Transformer。我们进一步发现，字节Transformer像外部分词器一样构建局部文本抽象：一组类似分割的位置被用来收集局部上下文表示，并且限制高达25%的中间层使用这些局部表示可以保持下游性能。最后，这些学习到的结构导致生成难度高度不均匀，不确定性集中在局部结构边界附近；利用它们进行推测解码比子词Transformer多生成3.4倍的接受标记。

articles.title: StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs
articles.abstract: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.
articles.titleCn: StagQ：面向LLMs的约束驱动多精度权重量化
articles.abstractCn: 在跨多个部署环境中服务大型语言模型（LLM）需要多种权重量精度操作点。多精度格式通过一个流来服务它们全部，该流的每个前缀都是有效的低精度代码，而不是存储多个副本。我们提出了StagQ，一种多精度权重量格式，其主流是一个2位分组仿射基，随后在二进制步进调度上跟随着可配置数量的1位精炼平面。每个支持精度都是一个可读的前缀，通过一个从所有精度共享的元数据中推导出的仿射映射进行解码，无需每个权重的查找。一个稀疏的侧记录，在网格拟合前后填充，保存了网格服务最差的少数几个权重。我们报告了编码器的两种配置。在2位时，较便宜的配置在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4和OLMo-2-7B上比最强的多精度基线领先3.1到7.0 MMLU点，但逻辑率略低。在3位时，它在Llama-3.1-8B上领先，在Phi-4上以更高速率领先，在OLMo-2-7B上持平。在4位时，它在所有三个模型上持平，但速率更高。在一个使用NVIDIA A100 GPU的批处理一次矩阵向量乘法中，使用合成权重计时，我们的内核在大多数形状精度情况下比两个基线内核更快。

articles.title: Can Language Models Learn to Reject Their Own Bad Reasoning Steps?
articles.abstract: Verifier-guided decoding can prevent harmful reasoning steps from contaminating subsequent generation, but typically relies on an external learned verifier. We ask whether a language model can instead reject its own bad reasoning steps. We define a prefix's recoverability as the probability that the frozen generator can complete it correctly. Diagnostics show that adjacent recoverability changes are often difficult to resolve with practical Monte Carlo budgets, while same-prefix candidates exhibit a sparse low-recoverability tail. We introduce Self-Step Rejection (SSR), which trains a lightweight LoRA acceptance gate on the generator backbone while keeping the base model frozen. SSR uses confidence-qualified first-passage supervision: steps before the first resolved crossing of a root-relative recoverability barrier are accepted, the crossing step is rejected, and unresolved steps and suffixes are excluded. Training combines pointwise classification, same-prefix pairwise learning, and group-relative policy refinement using final-answer correctness. At inference, SSR accepts candidates or resamples from the unchanged prefix under rejection budgets, without an external learned verifier. Across three reasoning models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR improves macro-average accuracy over single-pass decoding by 5.4--10.1 points using 1.21--1.40x as many generated tokens, and achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among evaluated step-level methods. Full-solution scaling methods require 4.47--8.27x the single-pass token cost for comparable performance.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型能否学会拒绝自身错误的推理步骤？
articles.abstractCn: 验证器引导解码可以防止有害推理步骤污染后续生成，但通常依赖于外部学习到的验证器。我们探究语言模型是否可以拒绝自身的错误推理步骤。我们将前缀的可恢复性定义为冻结的生成器正确完成它的概率。诊断显示，相邻的可恢复性变化通常难以在实用的蒙特卡洛预算下解决，而相同前缀候选则表现出稀疏的低可恢复性尾部。我们引入了自步拒绝（SSR），该技术在不冻结基础模型的情况下，在生成器主干上训练一个轻量级的LoRA接受门。SSR使用置信度合格的首次通过监督：在根相对可恢复性障碍物首次解决交叉之前的步骤被接受，交叉步骤被拒绝，未解决的步骤和后缀被排除。训练结合了逐点分类、相同前缀成对学习和使用最终答案正确性进行组相对策略细化。在推理时，SSR在拒绝预算下接受候选或从未更改的前缀重新采样，无需外部学习到的验证器。在三个推理模型和五个数学推理基准测试中，SSR在使用1.21--1.40倍生成的token的情况下，比单次解码将宏平均准确率提高了5.4--10.1分，并在评估的逐步级方法中实现了最高宏平均准确率。全解扩展方法需要4.47--8.27倍的单次token成本才能获得相当的性能。

articles.title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
articles.abstract: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.
articles.comment: Extended version of "OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation", accepted at ICML 2026, with additional analysis and scaling to HuatuoGPT-3
articles.titleCn: 华图GPT-3：基于基础模型的纯强化学习领域自适应
articles.abstractCn: 领域自适应旨在将通用的大型语言模型（LLM）转变为特定领域的专家。虽然占主导地位的超参数微调+强化学习（SFT+RL）流程提供了便捷的冷启动方法，但它可能会降低探索多样性，并通过多阶段优化引入额外复杂性。这些局限性促使人们探索纯强化学习自适应方法。然而，纯在线策略强化学习存在冷启动问题，而混合策略强化学习仍存在不足：教师输出中的信息性标记在早期训练中学习速度过慢，而陈旧的教师输出会阻碍后续改进。我们识别出这两种失效模式，分别称为梯度饥饿和教师分布锚定。为解决这些问题，我们提出了单阶段策略优化（OnePO），将教师输出视为策略改进的临时指导。OnePO结合了自适应目标进化来强化对信息性低概率教师标记的学习，并通过教师退休机制丢弃当前策略能够超越的教师输出。在医疗领域自适应任务中，OnePO仅使用20K训练样本就在HealthBench（总）上取得了67.2分的成绩，分别比SFT+RL和纯强化学习高出2.7和7.4分。我们进一步将OnePO扩展为生成开源医疗LLM系列HuatuoGPT-3，其27B版本在HealthBench（总）上达到70.1分，在HealthBench专业版上达到71.4分，超越了GPT-6 Astra等前沿模型。模型和代码可在https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3获取。

articles.title: TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation
articles.abstract: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator's own favorite only 34-55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.
articles.titleCn: TasteRoute：视频生成个性化路由
articles.abstractCn: 视频生成技术的快速发展催生了众多能力与生成成本差异显著的模式。这自然引出一个问题：能否高效地将每个请求路由到合适的模型？我们发现，即便使用其他标注者的共识作为预言机，其与每个标注者自己的首选模型也仅达成34-55%的共识。基于这一观察，我们提出了TasteRoute，一种个性化视频生成路由器，该路由器根据输入请求、用户偏好和可用生成预算联合选择生成器。在文本到视频和图像到视频的场景中，TasteRoute在偏好路由方面与强大的简单基线具有竞争力，同时降低了平均生成成本。在更高的预算上限下，成本节约效果更为显著。最后，我们发布了TasteRoute-3k，这是一个包含多模型视频对比、质量判断、偏好排名和用户特征信号的人工标注数据集，旨在促进未来关于个性化与成本感知视频路由的研究。

articles.title: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
articles.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this. Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention accordingly. Building on this observation, we study targeted bias injection, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary. The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the strength of a steering vector on the fly. On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from 1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6% to 58.1%. Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU. On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls well short. Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather than the frozen model alone.
articles.titleCn: 噪声外，偏差内：通过闭环激活引导在扩散语言模型中进行定向偏差注入
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过迭代去噪掩码位置来生成文本，在提交每个词元之前多次重新预测。自回归解码器在提交步骤仅暴露答案分布一次；而dLLM在提交前每个去噪步骤都暴露答案分布，我们展示了攻击者可以利用这一特性。由于答案在多个去噪步骤中仍可被修改，拥有内部激活访问权限的攻击者可以观察模型生成特定答案的可能性，并据此调整干预措施。基于这一观察，我们研究了目标偏见注入攻击，这是一种将冻结的dLLM引导至攻击者选定的人口统计学答案的攻击。该攻击使用一个简单的比例积分（PI）控制器，在去噪过程中追踪目标答案概率，并动态调整引导向量的强度。在正确答案为弃权的模糊BBQ问题上，我们的攻击将LLaDA-8B-Instruct对目标群体的偏好从1.8个百分点提升至16.7个百分点，超过最强固定强度引导基线的三倍以上；在SocialStigmaQA上，它将歧视性答案的选择率从17.6%提升至58.1%。针对其他人口统计学目标，同一攻击可将答案偏移高达37个百分点，且每次攻击在单个GPU上耗时约40分钟。在主要目标上，反馈是攻击成功的关键：在词元提交步骤以相同平均强度持续引导，产生的偏移远小于破坏近三倍的输出；而分别为每个示例设置固定强度的引导仍然效果不佳。我们的研究将去噪轨迹识别为dLLM中的新控制通道，并呼吁进行审查服务堆栈而非仅审查冻结模型的偏见审计。

articles.title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.
articles.titleCn: 从宏观社会信号中模拟个体
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于模拟个体对新情境的反应，然而这些反应背后的行为推理要么继承自预训练，要么从个体级别的标注中学习，而这些标注提供了有限的行为多样性和对推理本身的少量监督。我们提出从预测市场中学习行为推理，其价格轨迹记录了人群如何大规模地对现实世界事件做出反应。我们引入了macro2mind，它使用市场信号通过GRPO训练语言模型。通过社会行为分解，行为推理成为预测的一个明确步骤：模型推断市场参与者的代表性群体，预测每个群体如何解读新闻并更新其信念，推理他们的互动，并将这些反应聚合为价格。一个具有难度感知采样的后见之明后悔课程将训练集中在后见之明识别的群体在大幅提高预测的同时，优先考虑当前策略仍可学习的示例。学习到的推理适用于用户模拟，无需进一步训练。在SWM-Bench上，macro2mind在Polymarket上实现了最先进的方向准确性和相关性。在市场数据上训练后，它可以零样本迁移到四个用户模拟基准（Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM和CAD），并在零样本方法中具有竞争力。作为数据生成器使用时，macro2mind还使下游模拟器对未见过用户的准确率提高了15.5分，优于其骨干模型生成的数据13.2分。

articles.title: Learning to Learn a Language
articles.abstract: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Code: https://github.com/cbl/prior-fitted-language-model, weights: https://huggingface.co/lennartcb/pflm1
articles.titleCn: 学习如何学习语言
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了先验适配语言模型（PFLM），这是一个参数量为3亿字节级Transformer模型，仅使用来自合成非语言先验样本进行预训练。给定真实文本的前缀，它能够在冻结权重的情况下学习预测上下文中的语言，且从未见过任何真实语言中的单词。每个训练序列都由从这类模型分布中随机抽取的递归结构因果模型生成。在训练过程中，模型不会遇到两次相同的语言，因此预测延续的唯一方式是从前缀中推断语言。来自该先验的样本与自然文本共享统计特征：齐夫频率分布、缓慢的熵率收敛以及长程依赖性。在六种语言的维基百科上，每字比特数从均匀的8比特降至在一百万字节上下文中的0.9至2.4比特。给定数字而非文本时，PFLM学会计数、比较大小和近似加法。它预测了如鲁丁-沙波或素数指示器等确定性序列，并将六种非文本领域（从源代码到语音）的压缩率低于gzip和PPMd。该模型并未学习语言，而是学会了如何学习语言。

articles.title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
articles.abstract: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.
articles.titleCn: 离线策略合并优于在线策略自蒸馏在持续学习中
